The spark is not a projectile: projectile bonuses do not change it.

Only Projectile, Chain, Nova and Skyfall spells can become a totem (not Winter Orb, Orbiting Hammers or any Spark). Spell Echo and other spell repeats also echo the totem's casts, each echo dealing 20% less damage (a totem's pace ignores cast speed). The skill's other supports apply to the totem's casts. A trigger (Cast on Crit and the like) casts the spell itself and never places a totem. 35% less damage. For bow skills, use Arrow Totem.

Totems and Ballistas of one skill share their damage: each past the first adds 80% of one's damage, and each past the sixth adds 20%.

changes.name: Skyfall
lines: The skill strikes from the sky at its target instead of travelling (every chain target is struck from above; a bow's arrows drop point-first). A Nova falls on its target up to 9 metres away and blooms there. On Earthshatter a meteor of the slam's element falls at the end of the fissure. Only Projectile, Chain, Brand and Nova spells (every Spark), projectile attacks (not Crescent Slash's wave) and the Ballista's volley can fall; each enemy is struck once per use. Spells deal 20% more damage. A skill takes one shape: with Orbit, Rain, Trap or Totem also socketed, the first one socketed is used (a Totem or Trap always places it) and Skyfall adds only its damage. Winter Orb and Orbiting Hammers keep circling.

lines: The skill is thrown as a trap (up to 3, 16 seconds). Not on Winter Orb, Orbiting Hammers, Crescent Slash or the Storm, Rime and Venom Sparks: they cannot be thrown. changes.name: Cast on Crit
lines: When one of your attacks lands a critical hit, the spell this is socketed in casts itself at the enemy struck, for 50% of its mana cost. Spells that cast themselves this way take turns: at most one of them every 0.3 seconds. The triggered spell deals 25% less damage. In an attack or a spell, its crits cast the spell dropped on its link. On top of that, every Cast on Crit you have shares one clock: at most one cast every 0.15 seconds, taking turns, so one critical hit casts one spell; with nothing linked, the attack strikes by itself when your other attacks crit, at most once every 0.75 seconds for all such attacks, for a further 44% less damage (a Rain drops one wave, and Repeat, Afterimage or Multistrike never repeat it). Movement skills, Blade Vortex, Sheathe, channels, auras and Heralds never cast or strike by themselves: link a spell to them. One link per skill. Triggered spells must be on your skill bar, are never placed as totems or traps, and never trigger anything themselves. Fits totems and ballistas too: a totem's trigger fires at most once per second. A totem's or ballista's crit casts only the spell on its own link, never your other Cast on Crit spells.

changes.name: Cast on Crit
lines: When one of your attacks lands a critical hit, the spell this is socketed in casts itself at the enemy struck, for 50% of its mana cost. Spells that cast themselves this way take turns: at most one of them every 0.3 seconds. The triggered spell deals 25% less damage. In an attack or a spell, its crits cast the spell dropped on its link. On top of that, every Cast on Crit you have shares one clock: at most one cast every 0.15 seconds, taking turns, so one critical hit casts one spell; with nothing linked, the attack strikes by itself when your other attacks crit, at most once every 0.75 seconds for all such attacks, for a further 44% less damage (a Rain drops every wave, each at its share of the damage, and Repeat, Afterimage or Multistrike never repeat it). Movement skills, Blade Vortex, Sheathe, channels, auras and Heralds never cast or strike by themselves: link a spell to them. One link per skill. Triggered spells must be on your skill bar, are never placed as totems or traps, and never trigger anything themselves. Fits totems and ballistas too: a totem's trigger fires at most once per second. A totem's or ballista's crit casts only the spell on its own link, never your other Cast on Crit spells.

What it does depends on the skill it sits in.
In a spell with nothing linked: the spell casts itself at the enemy struck when one of your attacks lands a critical hit, for 50% of its mana cost. All such spells take turns on one clock: at most one cast every 0.3 seconds.
In an attack with nothing linked: the attack strikes by itself when another of your attacks lands a critical hit. All such attacks share one clock of 0.75 seconds and deal 58% less damage in all (a Rain drops every wave, each at its share of the damage; Repeat, Afterimage and Multistrike never repeat it). Blade Vortex fills and renews its ring this way. In a channelled attack, its own critical hits release a crit pulse, its hit again around it, on that same clock.
With a spell linked (any skill that hits): its critical hits cast that spell.
Only attacks' critical hits set off the unlinked ones; a spell's critical hits cast only its own link. All your Cast on Crit share one 0.15 second clock, so one critical hit casts one skill. Triggered skills deal 25% less damage, must be on your skill bar and never trigger anything. Only spells can be linked. Movement skills, Sheathe, channelled spells, Heralds, Vows and auras never cast or strike by themselves. In a totem or ballista it casts only its own link, at most once per second.

On a Rare, Unique or Guardian the Sentence holds until it dies and grows by itself, up to +30% (32.5% less damage dealt).

lines: Sentence one enemy: it takes 45% more damage from Bleed, Poison and Ignite. Damage from hits is not raised. changes.name: Vow of Precision

changes.name: Herald of Steel
lines: Swear the Herald of Steel: every hit you deal gains a share of its damage as extra physical damage (9% at gem level 1, 17.55% at 20), and your kills burst into shards of steel: 9% of the slain enemy's maximum life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as physical damage within 2.5 metres. changes.name: Oath of the Fallen
lines: Swear an Oath of the Fallen: every 5th enemy killed within 12 metres of you rises as a spectral oathsworn at your side for 5 seconds (6.9 at gem level 20). Each spirit grants 3% increased attack and cast speed and 1% reduced damage taken. Spirits add up with no limit but their time: 10 spirits are 30% increased speed and 10% reduced damage taken. Reserves 25% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the spirits leave you, you gain 12% more attack and cast speed for 4 seconds, then the Oath cannot be sworn for 10 seconds.

changes.name: Elemental Echo
lines: Swear an Elemental Echo: a kill leaves an echo of the killing hit's element for 4 seconds (5.9 at gem level 20), renewed by every kill of that element. Each echo grants 12% more damage of its element: fire, cold, lightning, poison or physical. Several elements echo at once, so a build that kills with two elements keeps both. Reserves 25% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): 20% more damage for 4 seconds, then the Echo cannot be sworn for 10 seconds.

changes.name: Grave Golem
lines: Tear a golem of grave-fire out of the earth. It is enormous, soaks up blows meant for you and smashes the ground around it; it burns in the colour of its supports' element. Only one answers at a time. Each golem blesses those near it: the grave golem heals you 1% of your life a second, the flame golem gives your minions 12.5% more damage, the ice golem gives you 31% more armour, the storm golem makes your minions 15% faster, and the venom golem makes enemies take 7.5% more damage. A blessing grows with your minion damage and minion life increases: 70% of its strength with none, full strength from 100% combined. The golem grows with your level: the deeper the Ruptures, the harder it hits.

changes.name: Ballista
lines: Plant a ballista where you aim (up to 9 metres away) that turns on the nearest enemy and looses heavy bolts for 10 seconds. One at a time: the Multiple Totems support, the passive tree, gear and your Dragonling's Arcane Lattice add more. Bow engine: your Ballistas and Arrow Totems share one limit (6 + bonuses): past it a new one replaces your oldest, and each count past it gives every bow engine 8% more damage instead. Supports on this gem change its bolts. Each bolt pierces one enemy; with Chain or Fork linked it chains or forks at its first enemy instead.

changes.name: Elemental Focus
lines: 12% more and 25% increased Fire, Cold and Lightning damage on any skill (Physical and Chaos gain nothing), but the supported skill's Ignites deal 40% less damage.

changes.name: Life Leech
lines: 1.5% of the damage the skill deals is leeched as life, and it deals 15% more damage while you are leeching (below full life).

changes.name: Bloodbound
lines: The linked skill costs life instead of mana (20% more cost) and deals 7% more damage, another 10% more while you are below half your life. The classic way to keep a channel running on an empty mana pool: pair it with Siphon or Vow of Vigor.

changes.name: Woebringer

changes.name: Spell Totem
lines: The spell is no longer cast by you: casting places a totem where you aim (up to 9 metres away; 1 at a time, 8 seconds) that casts it at the nearest enemy every 0.8 seconds. Only Projectile, Chain, Nova and Skyfall spells can become a totem (not Winter Orb, Orbiting Hammers, Living Orb (you fly it yourself) or any Spark). Spell Echo and other spell repeats also echo the totem's casts, each echo dealing 20% less damage (a totem's pace ignores cast speed). The skill's other supports apply to the totem's casts. Spell totem: shares the Totem limit with your other totems (10 + bonuses). 35% less damage. A Totem's Judgement strikes for 60% of your own cast. For bow skills, use Arrow Totem.

changes.name: Arrow Totem
lines: The bow skill is no longer fired by you: firing places a totem where you aim (up to 9 metres away; 1 at a time, 8 seconds) that fires it at the nearest enemy every 0.8 seconds. Only bow skills that shoot arrows can become a totem (not Rain of Arrows, Wind Vault or the Ballista). The skill's other supports apply to the totem's shots, and Multiple Totems adds more totems. Bow engine: your Arrow Totems share the Ballista limit with your Ballistas (6 + bonuses), each count past it gives every bow engine 8% more damage instead. 60% less damage.

changes.name: Multiple Totems
lines: You may have 1 additional totem or ballista of the supported skill at once, and it recovers 20% faster. Gem levels never add totems; the passive tree and items can add more. 20% less damage. All your skills together stand at most 6 bow engines (Ballistas and Arrow Totems) and 10 spell totems. Totems and Ballistas of one skill share their damage: each past the first adds 50% of one's damage.

changes.name: Skyfall
lines: The skill strikes from the sky at its target instead of travelling (every chain target is struck from above; a bow's arrows drop point-first). A Nova falls on its target up to 9 metres away and blooms there. On Earthshatter a meteor of the slam's element falls at the end of the fissure. Only Projectile, Chain, Brand and Nova spells (every Spark), projectile attacks (not Crescent Slash's wave) and the Ballista's volley can fall; each enemy is struck once per use, and a projectile that falls takes your Skyfall damage bonuses, not your Projectile ones. A skill takes one shape: with Orbit, Rain, Trap or Totem also socketed, the first one socketed is used (a Totem or Trap always places it) and Skyfall adds only its Skyfall tag, so your Skyfall bonuses still count. Winter Orb and Orbiting Hammers keep circling, and Living Orb (you fly it yourself) never falls.

changes.name: Tether
lines: Each enemy hit is linked to up to 2 other enemies within 5 metres for 3 seconds; linked enemies take 15% of the hit's damage per second.

changes.name: Orbit
lines: The skill's projectiles first circle you for 1.5 seconds, then each flies at the nearest enemy (a bow's arrows circle nose-first). Spells gain +1 projectile. Attacks deal 65% less damage. Not on a skill that already circles you, such as Orbiting Hammers or Winter Orb (each keeps its own ring), and not on Crescent Slash's wave. Every projectile circles, up to 24 at once. Every projectile strikes; one sent at an enemy this cast already struck deals 75% less damage (an arrow or thrown blade 90% less: spread them over a pack). A skill takes one shape: Orbit keeps it circling even with Meteor Lore (the fall gives way), and with another shape gem socketed the first one socketed is used.

changes.name: Rain
lines: The projectiles no longer fly: they go up and rain down on the target area, striking every enemy inside three times (four times with 4 or more projectiles). 50% less damage. A Ballista's bolts rain down on its target twice. Not on Winter Orb, Orbiting Hammers or Crescent Slash's wave: they cannot rain.

changes.name: Trap
lines: The skill is thrown as a trap (up to 3, 16 seconds). Not on Winter Orb, Orbiting Hammers, Crescent Slash, Living Orb (you fly it yourself) or the Storm, Rime and Venom Sparks: they cannot be thrown. It is live the moment it lands and goes off the instant an enemy comes within 4 metres; its first strike deals 15% more damage, then it re-arms about a second later (sooner with faster re-arm). It also fits a bow Ballista. A Trap that goes off sets off your other Traps nearby. 12% more damage and 25% increased damage. Your Traps out at once share their damage: each Trap past the first adds 20% of a Trap's damage.

Only the Physical part counts: damage converted to an element (Lightning, Flame, Ice or Venom linked) gains nothing from Maim.

changes.name: Ruthless
lines: Every third blow is a Ruthless blow: 60% more Physical damage and a heavy, bloody impact. Works on minions: every third blow of each minion.

changes.name: Executioner
lines: The physical finisher: 35% more damage against enemies below half their life on the physical part of a hit (14% on its fire, cold, lightning and poison), and hits kill enemies left below 10% of their life (Guardians too). Works with bows and on minions.

changes.name: Focused Volley
lines: The linked bow skill fires 1 more arrow, and all its arrows fly on one line at your target, each with its own hit, so one enemy can take every arrow. Each arrow after the first deals 60% of the one before it (2 arrows: 100% + 60%; 4 arrows: 100% + 60% + 36% + 22%), and the skill deals 15% less damage. A Guardian killer: you give up the spread. Every 5th Melee hit on the same enemy bursts for 100% of that hit as Physical damage to enemies within 2.5 m (up to 6 bursts a second), and your Orbit skills have 25% reduced mana cost

Your critical strikes on Rare, Unique and Guardian enemies deal 15% more damage, and your Melee skills have 20% reduced mana cost

Unholy Void opens where you aim, up to 10 m away, and no longer drains your Life; cast it again elsewhere to move it, on it to close it, and your Poison skills have 25% reduced mana cost

lines: Drain Life reaches twice as far (16 m) and its tether holds while you move; when the drained enemy dies the tether jumps to the nearest enemy without restarting, and your channelling skills deal 20% more damage, and your channelling skills cost 25% less mana

Drain Life reaches twice as far (16 m) and its tether holds while you move; when the drained enemy dies the tether jumps to the nearest enemy without restarting, and your channelling skills deal 20% more damage, and your channelling skills have 25% reduced mana cost

changes.name: Zap
lines: A spell: lightning strikes the enemy from the sky, then chains to 1 more, a tenth less on each jump. Your staff's mana skill; Arcane Bolt is its free attack. (The Lightning and Added Lightning supports put lightning on your other skills.)
A spell: lightning strikes the enemy from the sky, then chains to 1 more. Your staff's mana skill; Arcane Bolt is its free attack.

changes.name: Ground Slam
lines: Slam the ground: a shockwave of dust and cracking earth bursts out in a cone in front of you, damaging every enemy it reaches and staggering those it hits hard.
Slam the ground: a shockwave bursts out in a cone in front of you, damaging every enemy it reaches.

changes.name: Move
lines: Walk towards the cursor, ignoring enemies, items and the portal. Put it on a key as a force move: Left Click still walks and fights.
Walk towards the cursor, ignoring enemies, items and the portal. Put it on a key as a force move.

changes.name: Vow of Clarity
lines: Swear a Vow of clear thought: you regenerate mana. Reserves a small, flat amount of mana while sworn (it fits an early mana pool). Press again to break it (Vowbreak): for 4 seconds your skills cost no mana, then the Vow cannot be sworn for 10 seconds and you are Forsworn.
Swear a Vow that regenerates your mana. Break it for 4 seconds of free skills.

changes.name: Vow of Vigor
lines: Swear a Vow of the living body: you regenerate life, and your attacks gain a little mana on hit. Reserves 16% of your mana while sworn. Vowbreak: heal a quarter of your life at once and regenerate far faster for 4 seconds.
Swear a Vow that regenerates your life and gives mana on hit. Break it to heal a quarter of your life.

changes.name: Woe of Withering
lines: Lay a Woe on every enemy in an area: they take 30% more Poison damage and move 15% slower (at no Dread). Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it: the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread (+3% Woe effect per Dread, up to 20). An enemy that dies under it spreads the Woe to 2 nearby enemies. Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.
Lay a Woe on every enemy in an area: they take more Poison damage and move slower, and one that dies passes it to 2 enemies nearby. Hold to channel it; the area follows your cursor and the Woe grows.

changes.name: Toll of Dread
lines: Ring the toll: every Woe in an area is consumed and each cursed enemy takes Poison damage, 10% more per Dread it carried.
Ring the toll: every Woe in the area is consumed and each cursed enemy takes Poison damage, more for each Dread.

changes.name: Death Sentence
lines: Sentence one enemy: it takes 22% more damage from everything. Only one enemy can be Sentenced; sentencing another lifts the first. When it dies you gain an Insight charge. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian the Sentence holds until it dies and grows by itself, up to +30% (28.6% more damage taken).
Sentence one enemy: it takes more damage from everything. When it dies you gain an Insight charge.

changes.name: Jarl's Roar
lines: A war cry of the old jarls: enemies around you turn on you, and you gain a Resolve charge for each enemy it reaches (up to 3). Resolve: 6% reduced physical damage taken and +6% to elemental resistances per charge.
A war cry that makes nearby enemies turn on you. You gain Resolve for each enemy it reaches: less physical damage taken and more elemental resistance.

changes.name: War Banner
lines: Plant your War Banner where you aim (up to 8 metres away); use it again to move it. Enemies within 6 metres of the banner (further with Area of Effect: area supports and increased area reach it, counted each time you plant or move the banner) take 6% more damage. Every enemy that dies near it adds a Valour (+0.5% more, up to 20); a Rare, Unique or Guardian fighting near it adds one every 2 seconds. Moving the banner keeps half its Valour. Walk away and it falls. An enemy under both your banner and your Hunter's Marks takes both: they add together.
Plant a War Banner where you aim. Enemies near it take more damage, and every kill near it adds more. Use it again to move it.

changes.name: Woe of Cinders
lines: Lay a Woe of Cinders on every enemy in an area: its Fire resistance falls by 20 and it takes 8% more Fire damage (at no Dread). Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it (the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread, +3% effect per Dread, up to 20). Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.
Lay a Woe of Cinders on every enemy in an area: its Fire resistance falls and it takes more Fire damage. Hold to channel it; the area follows your cursor and the Woe grows.

changes.name: Woe of Rime
lines: Lay a Woe of Rime on every enemy in an area: its Cold resistance falls by 20, it takes 8% more Cold damage and it moves 10% slower (at no Dread). Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it (the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread, +3% effect per Dread, up to 20). Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.
Lay a Woe of Rime on every enemy in an area: its Cold resistance falls, it takes more Cold damage and it moves slower. Hold to channel it; the area follows your cursor and the Woe grows.

changes.name: Woe of Entropy
lines: Lay a Woe of Entropy on every enemy in an area: it takes 20% more Chaos damage and Entropy laid on it implodes 0.5 seconds sooner (at no Dread). Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it (the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread, +3% effect per Dread, up to 20). Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.
Lay a Woe of Entropy on every enemy in an area: it takes more Chaos damage and Entropy on it implodes sooner. Hold to channel it; the area follows your cursor and the Woe grows.

changes.name: Woe of the Tempest
lines: Lay a Woe of the Tempest on every enemy in an area: its Lightning resistance falls by 20 and it takes 8% more Lightning damage (at no Dread). Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it (the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread, +3% effect per Dread, up to 20). Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.
Lay a Woe of the Tempest on every enemy in an area: its Lightning resistance falls and it takes more Lightning damage. Hold to channel it; the area follows your cursor and the Woe grows.

changes.name: Woe of Sundering
lines: Lay a Woe of Sundering on every enemy in an area: it takes 30% more Physical damage (at no Dread). Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it (the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread, +3% effect per Dread, up to 20). Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.
Lay a Woe of Sundering on every enemy in an area: it takes more Physical damage. Hold to channel it; the area follows your cursor and the Woe grows.

changes.name: Woe of Faltering
lines: Lay a Woe of Faltering on every enemy in an area: its hits deal 20% less damage and it moves 20% slower (at no Dread). Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it (the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread, +3% effect per Dread, up to 20). Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.
Lay a Woe of Faltering on every enemy in an area: its hits deal less damage and it moves slower. Hold to channel it; the area follows your cursor and the Woe grows.

changes.name: Herald of Embers
lines: Swear a Herald of fire: every hit you deal gains a share of its damage as extra fire damage (10% at gem level 1, 19.5% at 20), and your kills (and your minions' and totems' kills) burst into flame: 12% of the slain enemy's maximum life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as fire damage within 2.5 metres. Reserves 20% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the extra damage is 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Herald cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Scales with your Fire and Elemental damage and the hit's own skill modifiers; the kill effect is always a share of the slain enemy's life. Skills linked to Brutality gain nothing from it.
Swear a Herald of fire: your hits gain extra fire damage, and kills burst into flame. Break it for a short surge of power.

changes.name: Herald of Rime
lines: Swear a Herald of cold: every hit you deal gains a share of its damage as extra cold damage (10% at gem level 1, 19.5% at 20), and your kills (and your minions' and totems' kills) shatter: 10% of the slain enemy's maximum life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as cold damage within 3 metres (it chills). Reserves 20% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the extra damage is 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Herald cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Scales with your Cold and Elemental damage and the hit's own skill modifiers; the kill effect is always a share of the slain enemy's life. Skills linked to Brutality gain nothing from it.
Swear a Herald of cold: your hits gain extra cold damage, and kills shatter and chill nearby foes. Break it for a short surge of power.

changes.name: Herald of Storms
lines: Swear a Herald of lightning: every hit you deal gains a share of its damage as extra lightning damage (10% at gem level 1, 19.5% at 20), and your kills (and your minions' and totems' kills) arc to the 3 nearest enemies within 5 metres: 8% of the slain enemy's maximum life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as lightning damage. Reserves 20% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the extra damage is 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Herald cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Scales with your Lightning and Elemental damage and the hit's own skill modifiers; the kill effect is always a share of the slain enemy's life. Skills linked to Brutality gain nothing from it.
Swear a Herald of lightning: your hits gain extra lightning damage, and kills arc to nearby enemies. Break it for a short surge of power.

changes.name: Herald of Rot
lines: Swear a Herald of poison: every hit you deal gains a share of its damage as extra poison damage (9% at gem level 1, 17.55% at 20), and your kills (and your minions' and totems' kills) burst into rot: 10% of the slain enemy's maximum life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as poison damage within 2.5 metres. Reserves 20% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the extra damage is 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Herald cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Scales with your Poison damage and the hit's own skill modifiers; the kill effect is always a share of the slain enemy's life.
Swear a Herald of poison: your hits gain extra poison damage, and kills burst into rot. Break it for a short surge of power.

changes.name: Vow of the Bulwark
lines: Swear a Vow against the elements and venom: +11.5% to fire, cold, lightning and poison resistances at gem level 1, +33.4% at 20 (never past your maximum). Reserves 20% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the resistances are 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Vow cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Break it just before a Guardian's big blow.
Swear a Vow that raises your fire, cold, lightning and poison resistances. Break it just before a Guardian blow.

changes.name: Vow of Iron
lines: Swear a Vow of iron: 28.8% more Armour at gem level 1, 50.6% at 20. Reserves 20% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the Armour bonus is 2.5 times as strong (about 126% more at 20) for 4 seconds, then the Vow cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Break it just before a Guardian's big blow.
Swear a Vow that gives you more Armour. Break it just before a Guardian blow.

changes.name: Vow of the Wind
lines: Swear a Vow of the wind: 28.8% more Evasion at gem level 1, 50.6% at 20. Reserves 20% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the Evasion bonus is 2.5 times as strong (about 126% more at 20) for 4 seconds, then the Vow cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Break it just before a Guardian's big blow.
Swear a Vow that gives you more Evasion. Break it just before a Guardian blow.

changes.name: Vow of Warding
lines: Swear a Vow of warding: 28.8% more Energy Shield and 23% faster Energy Shield recharge at gem level 1, 50.6% more and 44.9% faster at 20. Reserves 20% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): both bonuses are 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Vow cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Break it just before a Guardian's big blow.
Swear a Vow that gives you more Energy Shield and faster recharge. Break it just before a Guardian blow.

changes.name: Sentence of Chains
lines: Sentence one enemy: it takes 16% more Physical damage, deals 25% less damage and moves 15% slower. Only one enemy can be Sentenced, by any Sentence; sentencing another lifts the first. When it dies you gain a Resolve charge. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian the Sentence holds until it dies and grows by itself, up to +30% (32.5% less damage dealt).
Sentence one enemy: it takes more Physical damage, deals less damage and moves slower. When it dies you gain a Resolve charge.

changes.name: Sentence of Rot
lines: Sentence one enemy: it takes 45% more damage from Bleed, Poison and Ignite. Damage from hits is not raised. Only one enemy can be Sentenced, by any Sentence; sentencing another lifts the first. When it dies you gain an Insight charge. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian the Sentence holds until it dies and grows by itself, up to +30% (58.5% more). It adds with every other takes more damage effect, on Guardians too.
Sentence one enemy: it takes more damage from Bleed, Poison and Ignite. When it dies you gain an Insight charge.

changes.name: Sentence of Exposure
lines: Sentence one enemy: its Fire, Cold, Lightning and Poison resistance falls by 20% and it takes 11% more Fire, Cold and Lightning damage. A Woe that lowers the same resistance adds its cut on top (a Woe and a Sentence stack). Only one enemy can be Sentenced, by any Sentence; sentencing another lifts the first. When it dies you gain an Insight charge. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian the Sentence holds until it dies and grows by itself, up to +30% (-26% resistance).
Sentence one enemy: its Fire, Cold, Lightning and Poison resistances fall and it takes more elemental damage. When it dies you gain an Insight charge.

changes.name: Vow of Zeal
lines: Swear a Vow of zeal: 6.9% more Attack and Cast Speed at gem level 1, 13.5% at 20. Reserves 20% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the bonus is 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Vow cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Break it as a Guardian opens up.
Swear a Vow that raises your Attack and Cast Speed. Break it as a Guardian opens up.

changes.name: Vow of Precision
lines: Swear a Vow of precision: 46% increased Critical Strike Chance and +11.5% to Critical Strike Multiplier at gem level 1, 89.7% and +22.4% at 20. Reserves 20% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the bonus is 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Vow cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Break it as a Guardian opens up.
Swear a Vow that raises your Critical Strike Chance and Multiplier. Break it as a Guardian opens up.

changes.name: Vow of Judgement
lines: Swear a Vow of judgement: your damage Penetrates 5.75% Elemental Resistances at gem level 1, 11.2% at 20. Strongest where resistances are highest: Guardians and deep Ruptures. Reserves 20% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the bonus is 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Vow cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Break it as a Guardian opens up.
Swear a Vow that makes your damage Penetrate Elemental Resistances. Break it as a Guardian opens up.

changes.name: Herald of Steel
lines: Swear the Herald of Steel: every hit you deal gains a share of its damage as extra physical damage (9% at gem level 1, 17.55% at 20), and your kills (and your minions' and totems' kills) burst into shards of steel: 9% of the slain enemy's maximum life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as physical damage within 2.5 metres. Reserves 20% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the extra damage is 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Herald cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Scales with: the hit's own skill modifiers and your Physical damage. Does not scale with: the kill effect, it is always a share of the slain enemy's life.
Swear the Herald of Steel: your hits gain extra physical damage, and kills burst into shards of steel. Break it for a short surge of power.

changes.name: Cinder Mites
lines: Summons 2 Cinder Mites (3 from gem level 10) that scuttle at your heels. They never fight and enemies never target them. Every 1.6 seconds each mite spits an ember at the nearest enemy within 6.5 metres: a hit of this gem's fire damage that always Ignites. Each mite within 6 metres of you grants 3% more fire damage (9% with 3 mites). Reserves 20% of your mana while one lives (7% for a Mage). Supports on this gem shape the embers; minion count supports add mites.
Summons Cinder Mites that scuttle at your heels and spit embers that Ignite the nearest enemy. They never fight and enemies never target them.

changes.name: Rime Sprites
lines: Summons 2 Rime Sprites (3 from gem level 10) that drift at your shoulder. They never fight and enemies never target them. Every 1.6 seconds each sprite breathes frost on every enemy within 3 metres of it: a hit of this gem's cold damage that Chills. Each sprite within 6 metres of you grants 3% more cold damage (9% with 3 sprites). Reserves 20% of your mana while one lives (7% for a Ranger). Supports on this gem shape the frost; minion count supports add sprites.
Summons Rime Sprites that drift at your shoulder and breathe frost that Chills nearby enemies. They never fight and enemies never target them.

changes.name: Brass Sentinels
lines: Summons 2 Brass Sentinels (3 from gem level 10), small steam driven clockwork guards that march at your side. They never fight and enemies never target them. Every 1.6 seconds each sentinel arcs lightning to the nearest enemy within 6.5 metres: a hit of this gem's lightning damage that always Shocks. Each sentinel within 6 metres of you grants 3% more lightning damage (9% with 3 sentinels). Reserves 20% of your mana while one lives (7% for a Warrior). Supports on this gem shape the arcs; minion count supports add sentinels.
Summons Brass Sentinels, clockwork guards that arc lightning that Shocks the nearest enemy. They never fight and enemies never target them.

changes.name: Oath of the Fallen
lines: Swear an Oath of the Fallen: every 5th enemy killed within 12 metres of you rises as a spectral oathsworn at your side for 5 seconds (6.9 at gem level 20). Each spirit grants 3% increased attack and cast speed and 1% reduced damage taken. Spirits add up with no limit but their time: 10 spirits are 30% increased speed and 10% reduced damage taken. Reserves 20% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the spirits leave you, you gain 12% more attack and cast speed for 4 seconds, then the Oath cannot be sworn for 10 seconds.
Swear an Oath of the Fallen: every 5th kill near you raises a spirit that grants attack and cast speed and less damage taken. Break it for a burst of speed.

changes.name: Elemental Echo
lines: Swear an Elemental Echo: a kill leaves an echo of the killing hit's element for 4 seconds (5.9 at gem level 20), renewed by every kill of that element. Each echo grants 12% more damage of its element: fire, cold, lightning, poison or physical. Several elements echo at once, so a build that kills with two elements keeps both. Reserves 20% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): 20% more damage for 4 seconds, then the Echo cannot be sworn for 10 seconds.
Swear an Elemental Echo: a kill leaves an echo of its element that grants more damage of that element. Break it for a short surge of power.

changes.name: Ancestral Warrior
lines: Raise a carved warrior statue up to 9 metres away for 10 seconds. Every 0.75 seconds it slams the ground at its feet with your weapon: an attack at this gem's damage against every enemy within 3 metres (area size widens it), so it only strikes when enemies close in. While you stand within 6 metres of it you have 10% increased attack speed. One at a time: the Multiple Totems support, the passive tree and gear add more. Slam and Melee supports on this gem change its blows. The statue has 50% of your maximum life.
Raise a carved warrior statue that slams the ground around it whenever enemies close in. You attack faster while you stand near it.

changes.name: Horn of the Jarls
lines: Plant a war horn up to 9 metres away for 12 seconds. Every 4 seconds it sounds: every enemy within 6.5 metres turns on the horn for 3 seconds, and while you stand within 9.5 metres of it you gain a Resolve charge for each enemy it reached, up to 3 a call (each charge: 6% reduced physical damage taken and +6% to elemental resistances). The horn has 80% of your maximum life. Area size widens the call. One at a time; the Multiple Totems support adds more.
Plant a war horn that calls nearby enemies onto it. While you stand near it you gain Resolve for each enemy it reached.

changes.name: Storm Whirl
lines: Hold to spin inside a crackling vortex, moving toward the cursor; lightning lashes everything around you and strikes one enemy every turn.
Hold to spin in a lightning vortex toward the cursor, shocking everything around you.

changes.name: Flame Dash
lines: Teleport a short distance toward the cursor in a burst of flame, leaving a burning path that sears enemies standing in it. Every half second the path deals half the damage shown, for 3 seconds. You cannot be hit for the first 0.25 seconds.
Teleport toward the cursor, leaving a burning path. You cannot be hit for the first 0.25 seconds.

changes.name: Winter Orb
lines: Conjure every orb of ice you can hold (one to start, more from passives and gear) by your shoulder for 10 seconds. They hurl icicles at nearby enemies (faster with cast speed and Winter Orb fire rate), then shatter in a frost explosion that chills everything around it. At your orb limit, casting again shatters the oldest orb at once.
Hold orbs of ice that hurl icicles at nearby enemies, then shatter in a chilling blast.

changes.name: Storm Spark
lines: Throw a crackling spark that latches onto an enemy. Every 0.5 seconds (sooner with cast speed and Spark strike rate) it strikes its host with lightning that leaps to 2 more enemies, a tenth less on each jump. When the host dies the spark jumps to another. Lasts 5 seconds. Each cast throws 2 sparks apart (3 from gem level 20); recasts add more up to your Spark limit (3 to start, more from passives and gear), then replace the oldest. Not a projectile: projectile bonuses do not change it. Link Cast on Crit and every critical hit from your attacks casts it for you.
Throw sparks that latch onto an enemy and strike it with chaining lightning. They jump on when it dies.

changes.name: Ember Spark
lines: Throw a smouldering spark that latches onto an enemy. Every 0.8 seconds (sooner with cast speed and Spark strike rate) it strikes its host with a heavy blow of fire that sets it burning. It never chains to other enemies: it is the spark for the one enemy that will not die. When the host dies the spark jumps to another. Lasts 6 seconds. Each cast throws 2 sparks apart (3 from gem level 20); recasts add more up to your Spark limit (3 to start, more from passives and gear), then replace the oldest. Not a projectile: projectile bonuses do not change it. Link Cast on Crit and every critical hit from your attacks casts it for you. Fits Trap Support: thrown as a trap, it latches onto the first enemy that sets it off.
Throw sparks that latch onto one enemy and burn it with heavy fire blows. They jump on when it dies.

changes.name: Rime Spark
lines: Throw a freezing spark that latches onto an enemy. Every 0.7 seconds (sooner with cast speed and Spark strike rate) it strikes its host with frost that leaps to 4 more enemies, a tenth less on each jump, chilling the whole pack. When the host dies the spark jumps to another. Lasts 5 seconds. Each cast throws 2 sparks apart (3 from gem level 20); recasts add more up to your Spark limit (3 to start, more from passives and gear), then replace the oldest. Not a projectile: projectile bonuses do not change it. Link Cast on Crit and every critical hit from your attacks casts it for you. Fits Trap Support: thrown as a trap, it latches onto the first enemy that sets it off.
Throw sparks that latch onto an enemy and strike with chaining frost that chills the pack.

changes.name: Venom Spark
lines: Throw a festering spark that latches onto an enemy. Every 0.4 seconds (sooner with cast speed and Spark strike rate) it strikes its host and 2 more enemies with venom, a tenth less on each jump, and every strike adds a poison: the longer it crawls, the deeper they rot. When the host dies the spark jumps to another. Lasts 7 seconds. Each cast throws 2 sparks apart (3 from gem level 20); recasts add more up to your Spark limit (3 to start, more from passives and gear), then replace the oldest. Not a projectile: projectile bonuses do not change it. Link Cast on Crit and every critical hit from your attacks casts it for you. Fits Trap Support: thrown as a trap, it latches onto the first enemy that sets it off.
Throw sparks that latch onto an enemy and chain venom, stacking poison the longer they crawl.

changes.name: Thunderfall
lines: Strike three times with your weapon (any weapon but a bow; a staff or wand suits it). The third blow calls lightning down on every enemy in front of you. Its damage is lightning: all of it is converted already, so a conversion support, gear or tree node shares that 100% with it instead of adding on top. Spell damage modifiers also apply to it.
Strike three times with your weapon. The third blow calls lightning down on the enemies in front of you.

changes.name: Glacial Shards
lines: Flick 3 shards of ice from your weapon (any weapon but a bow; a wand or staff suits it). Each bursts into frost on the first enemy it strikes, chilling everything nearby. Its damage is cold: all of it is converted already, so a conversion support, gear or tree node shares that 100% with it instead of adding on top. Spell damage modifiers also apply to it.
Flick shards of ice from your weapon. Each bursts on the first enemy it hits and chills nearby foes.

changes.name: Wayward Orb
lines: Loose orbs of raw power that settle over enemies. Every 0.6 seconds (sooner with cast speed and Spark strike rate) it strikes: the orb pulses on every enemy close around its host, and after every 3 pulses it leaps to the nearest other enemy and strikes at once. When its host dies it finds another. Lasts 5 seconds. Each cast throws 2 orbs apart (3 from gem level 20); recasts add more up to your Spark limit (3 to start, more from passives and gear), then replace the oldest. With Flame, Ice, Lightning or Venom linked, most of its damage becomes fire, cold, lightning or poison and the orb wears that element. It counts as a Spark, not a projectile.
Loose orbs that settle over enemies, pulse on everything near the host and leap on every third pulse.

changes.name: Living Orb
lines: Become a living orb of fire and fly from group to group around you, bursting on every enemy near each landing. 4 flights (4, plus 1 at gem level 10, 1 at 20 and 1 for each Chain). The last burst hits 60% harder. You end beside the last group you hit, or at once when you click to move or roll. With Ice, Lightning or Venom linked, the orb and its bursts turn cold, lightning or poison. Cast speed quickens the flights. Counts as a Movement skill. You cannot be hit while you fly, but a cast within 1 second of the last flight ending gives no protection. Only your own cast starts it: Cast on Crit and other triggers never do.
Become a living orb and fly between enemy groups, bursting on each. You cannot be hit while you fly.

changes.name: Reap
lines: Your scythe's basic attack, no mana cost. A wide, hungry sweep that cuts everything in front of you.
Your scythe's basic attack, no mana cost. A wide sweep that cuts everything in front of you.

changes.name: Death Coil
lines: Your scythe's mana skill. Hurl a coil of grave-magic that seeks the nearest foe ahead and bursts on it, rotting everything nearby.
Your scythe's mana skill. Hurl a grave-magic coil that seeks a foe and rots everything near it.

changes.name: Summon Skeletons
lines: Raise skeleton warriors from the ground: two, and one more at gem levels 8, 15 and 22 (every 7 gem levels). While you are below level 10 it raises 2 more and costs half the mana, a starter's help that ends at level 10. They follow you and fight until they fall.
Raise skeleton warriors that follow you and fight until they fall. Gem levels raise the count.

changes.name: Summon Skeletal Mage
lines: Raise skeletal mages that keep their distance and hurl bolts of dark magic at your foes: one, two from gem level 13, three from gem level 25. They stay until they fall.
Raise skeletal mages that keep their distance and hurl dark bolts. Gem levels raise the count.

changes.name: Drain Life
lines: Hold to tether the enemy under the cursor with a beam of grave-hunger: it rots while you drink, and the beam forks on to 3 more enemies nearby, each link a tenth weaker. A quarter of the damage comes back to you as life, and your minions drink with you.
Hold to tether the enemy under the cursor and rot it. The beam forks to 3 more enemies and heals you and your minions.

changes.name: Vampire Dash
lines: Come apart into mist and bats and gather again a short way toward the cursor. The mist lingers on your path and rots whatever stands in it. You cannot be hit for the first 0.25 seconds.
Turn to mist and bats and reform toward the cursor, rotting the path. You cannot be hit for the first 0.25 seconds.

changes.name: Grave Golem
lines: Tear a golem of grave-fire out of the earth. It is enormous, soaks up blows meant for you and smashes the ground around it. Supports change its damage, never its form or its blessing. Only one golem answers at a time. Use it again while the golem stands to send it leaping where you aim, once every 6 seconds. Its blessing: you regenerate 1% of your life a second near it, and the golem takes 15% of the damage of hits you take near it (never its last life point). A blessing grows with your minion damage and minion life increases: 50% of its strength with none, full strength from 100% combined. The golem grows with your level: the deeper the Ruptures, the harder it hits.
Tear up an enormous grave golem that soaks blows and smashes the ground. Its blessing regenerates your life.

changes.name: Flame Golem
lines: Tear a golem of living flame out of the earth. It is enormous, soaks up blows meant for you and smashes the ground around it. Supports change its damage, never its form or its blessing. Only one golem answers at a time. Use it again while the golem stands to send it leaping where you aim, once every 6 seconds. Its blessing: your minions near it deal 12.5% more damage, and enemies that die near it burst into flame for 6% of their life as Fire (the burst never bursts again). A blessing grows with your minion damage and minion life increases: 50% of its strength with none, full strength from 100% combined. The golem grows with your level: the deeper the Ruptures, the harder it hits.
Tear up an enormous flame golem that soaks blows and smashes the ground. Its blessing boosts your minions.

changes.name: Ice Golem
lines: Tear a golem of black ice out of the earth. It is enormous, soaks up blows meant for you and smashes the ground around it. Supports change its damage, never its form or its blessing. Only one golem answers at a time. Use it again while the golem stands to send it leaping where you aim, once every 6 seconds. Its blessing: you have 31% more armour near it. Enemies near it are chilled 15% and deal 8% less damage. A blessing grows with your minion damage and minion life increases: 50% of its strength with none, full strength from 100% combined. The golem grows with your level: the deeper the Ruptures, the harder it hits.
Tear up an enormous ice golem that soaks blows and smashes the ground. Its blessing gives you armour and chills foes.

changes.name: Storm Golem
lines: Tear a golem of caged storm out of the earth. It is enormous, soaks up blows meant for you and smashes the ground around it. Supports change its damage, never its form or its blessing. Only one golem answers at a time. Use it again while the golem stands to send it leaping where you aim, once every 6 seconds. Its blessing: your and your minions' hits Shock enemies near it for 10% more damage taken (a stronger Shock wins), and your minions near it are 15% faster. A blessing grows with your minion damage and minion life increases: 50% of its strength with none, full strength from 100% combined. The golem grows with your level: the deeper the Ruptures, the harder it hits.
Tear up an enormous storm golem that soaks blows and smashes the ground. Its blessing shocks foes and speeds your minions.

changes.name: Venom Golem
lines: Tear a golem of grave-venom out of the earth. It is enormous, soaks up blows meant for you and smashes the ground around it. Supports change its damage, never its form or its blessing. Only one golem answers at a time. Use it again while the golem stands to send it leaping where you aim, once every 6 seconds. Its blessing: enemies near it take 7.5% more damage. A blessing grows with your minion damage and minion life increases: 50% of its strength with none, full strength from 100% combined. The golem grows with your level: the deeper the Ruptures, the harder it hits.
Tear up an enormous venom golem that soaks blows and smashes the ground. Its blessing makes enemies take more damage.

changes.name: Raise Zombie
lines: Drag a zombie up out of the ground: two stand at once, three from gem level 24. Zombies stay until they fall, grow with the gem, hit hard and every fourth blow slams the ground round their foe. Supports such as Brutality or Flame make them brutal or burning.
Drag zombies out of the ground. They hit hard and every fourth blow slams the ground around their foe.

changes.name: Grave Call
lines: Call every minion you have to your side. They come running (those far away step out of the ground beside you) and close in round you, then fight on with 30% more damage, moving and attacking 20% faster, for 4 seconds.
Call all your minions to your side. They fight on with more damage and speed for 4 seconds.

changes.name: Unholy Void
lines: Open a void of unholy energy around you: enemies inside take poison damage twice a second, 70% of the damage shown each time. The void gnaws at you too: 0.9% of your life per second, less with poison resistance, never the last tenth of your life. Press again to close it.
Open a void around you that poisons enemies inside, and gnaws at you too. Press again to close it.

changes.name: Gravereap
lines: Sweep your weapon in a wide arc. Enemies it kills rise as Risen Thralls that fight for you until they fall: up to 3, and one more at gem levels 7, 13 and 19; a new one replaces the oldest. 40% of its damage is poison. On a Guardian or Unique enemy, where nothing dies, every 4% of its life your hits take raises one too.
Sweep in a wide arc. Enemies it kills rise as Risen Thralls that fight for you. Part of its damage is poison.

changes.name: Soul Rend
lines: Two heavy chops tear at the soul. Enemies hit are Rent for 4 seconds: your minions deal 10% more damage to them. 30% of its damage is poison.
Two heavy chops tear at the soul. Rent enemies take more damage from your minions.

changes.name: Marrow Lance
lines: Hurl a lance of bone that pierces through the line. Enemies it kills rise as Risen Casters that fight for you until they fall: up to 3, and one more at gem levels 7, 13 and 19; a new one replaces the oldest. 40% of its damage is poison. On a Guardian or Unique enemy, where nothing dies, every 4% of its life your hits take raises one too.
Hurl a bone lance that pierces the line. Enemies it kills rise as Risen Casters that fight for you.

changes.name: Pyre Burst
lines: Set a fresh corpse near your aim ablaze. It bursts in fire, hitting every enemy around it, and deals 10% of the slain's maximum life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as extra fire (20% at gem level 20). Your own fallen minions count as corpses. With no corpse there, your nearest minion is sacrificed instead, only when you cast it yourself (not from a trigger or conduit).
Set a fresh corpse near your aim ablaze. It bursts in fire, hitting every enemy around it.

changes.name: Gravefeast
lines: Hold to draw every fresh corpse within 6 metres of your aim into your minions. Each corpse gives your minions one Feast for 10 seconds (refreshed by each new corpse, up to 10 Feasts, 20 at gem level 20): each Feast is 1% more damage and 0.5% more attack and cast speed for your minions. While you hold it, every corpse your skills burst within its reach also counts as consumed.
Hold to draw fresh corpses near your aim into your minions. Each corpse gives them more damage and speed.

changes.name: Holy Slash
lines: A wide sweep that leaves a crescent of holy light, striking every enemy in front of you. Your mace's mana skill; Hammer Blow is its free attack.
A wide sweep that leaves a crescent of holy light, striking every enemy in front of you.

changes.name: Judgement
lines: Raise your weapon to the sky: a moment later bolts of holy light crash down on the target and the enemies nearest it, one after another, each exploding on impact. 4 bolts; one more at gem levels 10 and 20. The bolts are not projectiles: Projectile skill bonuses do not change them. Judgement is a Skyfall skill: every Skyfall line reaches it, and second fall lines (Twice Judged, Twice-Fallen Sky) drop the sky again where each bolt lands (each enemy takes one second fall per cast).
Raise your weapon to the sky: bolts of holy light crash down on the target and the enemies nearest it, one after another.

changes.name: Orbiting Hammers
lines: Needs a mace or hammer in your hand (Paladins call the hammers without one). Turn on a ring of 3 spectral hammers that sweeps out through the enemies around you and back again, smashing everything it passes. It drains 6 mana a second while it spins (more with supports); press again to turn it off, and it stops when your mana runs out. One more hammer at gem levels 4, 8, 12, 16 and 20; from five hammers a second, outer ring turns the other way and pulses out as the inner one comes in. Hammerstorm empowers it.
Turn on a ring of spectral hammers that sweeps out through the enemies around you and back, smashing everything it passes. Drains mana while it spins; press again to stop.

changes.name: Hammerstorm
lines: Needs a mace or hammer in your hand (Paladins call the hammers without one). Swear the hammers to the storm: for 6 seconds your spinning hammers turn half again as fast, reach 35% farther, hit 40% harder and three more hammers join them in a second ring. If no hammers are spinning, it calls them.
Swear the hammers to the storm: for 6 seconds your spinning hammers turn faster, reach farther, hit harder and gain a second ring.

changes.name: Consecrated Ground
lines: Plant your weapon and hallow the ground around you for 5 seconds. Enemies on it burn with holy light, are slowed, take 20% more damage from every hit and are struck critically more often (+8% chance); you regenerate 2% of your life per second while you stand on it.
Plant your weapon and hallow the ground around you. Enemies on it burn, slow, take more damage and are crit more often; you regenerate life.

changes.name: Holy Charge
lines: Charge behind your shield toward the cursor and bash the first enemy in your path, stunning it. Where the charge ends, holy light burns the ground for 2 seconds, slowing enemies and healing you. The bash deals the full damage shown; the holy light deals 35% of it every half second. Movement skill: cancels the end of an attack.
Charge behind your shield and stun the first enemy in your path. Where the charge ends, holy light burns the ground, slowing enemies and healing you.

changes.name: Holy Elemental
lines: Call down a Holy Elemental of living light. It fights at your side, smashing your foes with blows of holy light that strike everything around them, until it is destroyed. A second elemental answers at gem level 10. Its light shelters you: within 9 metres of it you have +6% chance to block (never past the 75% block cap, so a build already at the cap gains nothing from it) and regenerate 0.5% of your life a second. Shared Light: past 4 elementals, each deals 4% less per extra elemental standing (12: 32% less each). The army never shrinks, only the blow each one lands.
Call down a Holy Elemental of living light that fights at your side. It shelters you: more block chance and life regeneration near it.

changes.name: Pyre of Faith
lines: Light a pyre of holy fire around you: enemies inside burn twice a second for fire damage that grows with your maximum life. The pyre burns you too: 6% of your life per second, a quarter of that at 75% fire resistance, never the last tenth of your life: you need life regeneration. Press again to put it out. Its burn is a Fire spell hit: Fire, Spell, Area and Holy damage scale it; Burning damage modifiers scale Ignites, not the pyre. Added Fire damage to Spells adds its full value to every burn, but most of the burn comes from your life, so life is its main scaler. Maximum life here is your full life: Reserved Life counts.
Light a pyre of holy fire around you: enemies inside burn for damage that grows with your maximum life. It burns you too; press again to put it out.

changes.name: Hallowed Slam
lines: Bring your weapon down on the ground in front of you. Where it lands the ground is hallowed for 3 seconds, one new patch a second: enemies on it burn for 30% of the hit's damage twice a second and take 8% more damage from every hit, and you regain life while you stand in it.
Bring your weapon down on the ground in front of you. The ground is hallowed: enemies on it burn and take more damage, and you regain life.

changes.name: Shield Throw
lines: Hurl your shield at the enemy in front of you. It rings off the first enemy it strikes into the next, up to 3 more times, a little weaker at every leap. A Shield skill: while you hold a shield it gains 1% increased damage per 5 armour, evasion and energy shield on that shield, and Shield skill bonuses apply. Without a shield it keeps its full base damage.
Hurl your shield at the enemy in front of you. It rings off the first enemy into the next, a little weaker at every leap.

changes.name: Rain of Arrows
lines: Fire a volley into the sky. A moment later it rains down on the target area, striking every enemy inside three times. Aimed at an enemy, the volley leads it: it falls where that enemy will be when the arrows land.
Fire a volley into the sky that rains down on the target area, striking every enemy inside three times.

changes.name: Wind Vault
lines: Vault toward the cursor on a gust of wind (or back, away from it, when the cursor is close), shoving nearby enemies away on landing and loosing three arrows at the nearest. The damage shown is a full hit: each landing arrow deals 60% of it and the gust 15%. Cancels attacks. The arrows are not projectiles: Projectile skill bonuses do not change them. You cannot be hit for the first 0.25 seconds.
Vault on a gust of wind, shoving nearby enemies away on landing and loosing three arrows at the nearest. You cannot be hit for the first 0.25 seconds.

changes.name: Lightning Arrow
lines: Loose an arrow charged with lightning. Half its physical damage is converted to lightning. When it strikes an enemy, lightning leaps from it to 3 more enemies for 72% of the hit, a tenth less on each jump. The first enemy takes the full damage shown. With no other enemy in reach, the leaps it cannot make come back into that enemy as one extra strike, about 3% of the hit for each leap: about 29% more on a lone boss with 10 leaps.
Loose an arrow charged with lightning. When it strikes, lightning leaps to more enemies, a little weaker on each jump.

changes.name: Ballista
lines: Plant a ballista where you aim (up to 9 metres away) that turns on the nearest enemy and looses heavy bolts for 10 seconds. One at a time: the Multiple Totems support, the passive tree, gear and your Dragonling's Arcane Lattice add more. Bow engine: your Ballistas and Arrow Totems share one limit (7 + bonuses): past it a new one replaces your oldest, and each count past it gives every bow engine 5% more damage instead. Supports on this gem change its bolts. Each bolt pierces one enemy; with Chain or Fork linked it chains or forks at its first enemy instead.
Plant a ballista that turns on the nearest enemy and looses heavy bolts for 10 seconds.

changes.name: Caustic Arrow
lines: Loose a rotten arrow that bursts into a caustic cloud where it strikes, one new cloud a second. The cloud lingers for 3 seconds and poisons every enemy inside for 30% of the hit's damage twice a second. 60% of its damage is poison.
Loose a rotten arrow that bursts into a caustic cloud where it strikes, poisoning every enemy inside.

changes.name: Fuse Arrow
lines: Loose an arrow with a burning fuse. It bursts in fire where it strikes, hitting every enemy around the target. 60% of its damage is fire.
Loose an arrow with a burning fuse. It bursts in fire where it strikes, hitting every enemy around the target.

changes.name: Hoarfrost Volley
lines: Loose a close cone of 7 frost arrows. Their damage is cold and they chill what they hit. Each enemy is struck by one arrow.
Loose a close cone of frost arrows that chill what they hit.

changes.name: Flurry
lines: A storm of five quick cuts in front of you; the last one is a heavy finisher that throws enemies back. Your blades' mana skill; Twin Cuts is their free attack.
A storm of five quick cuts in front of you; the last is a heavy finisher that throws enemies back.

changes.name: Iaido Thrust
lines: Dash through enemies toward the cursor, cutting everything on your line. A moment later you sheathe and they bleed for a second cut. The dash cut deals the full damage shown, the sheathe cut 38% of it. Every enemy you cut stays marked for 5 seconds, and each new cut on a marked enemy adds 25% of that cut to its mark: Sheathe makes them burst. Movement skill: cancels the end of an attack. You cannot be hit for the first 0.2 seconds.
Dash through enemies toward the cursor, cutting everything on your line and marking them. Sheathe later bursts the marks. You cannot be hit for the first 0.2 seconds.

changes.name: Shuriken Fan
lines: Flick a fan of 5 spinning shuriken at the enemy. Each one cuts through 2 foes before it stops. One more at gem levels 10 and 18.
Flick a fan of spinning shuriken at the enemy. Each one cuts through several foes before it stops.

changes.name: Blade Vortex
lines: 3 spectral blades join a ring that circles you for 6 seconds, sweeping out into the pack and back, cutting every enemy they pass. Cast again to add more: up to 8 blades. While it is on your bar, every basic attack that lands adds a blade.
Spectral blades join a ring that circles you, sweeping out into the pack and back, cutting every enemy they pass. Every basic attack that lands adds a blade.

changes.name: Thousand Cuts
lines: Become a blur of steel: fly from group to group around you five times, cutting everything near each one. The last cut is the heaviest. You end beside the last group you cut. Counts as a Movement skill and as a dash: movement supports, passives, items and Echo Cut apply (Echo Cut adds one more cut where you end). It is still a melee attack. You cannot be hit while you fly.
Become a blur of steel: fly from group to group five times, cutting everything near each one. You cannot be hit while you fly.

changes.name: Sheathe
lines: Sheathe your blades with a click. Every enemy your Iaido Thrust has marked bursts apart, nearest first, for 160% of its mark, and half of that to everything around it. A mark is the strongest Iaido cut on that enemy plus 25% of every other cut it took while marked, so thrust through it a few times before you sheathe. Needs marks: cut enemies with Iaido Thrust first.
Sheathe your blades with a click: every enemy Iaido Thrust has marked bursts apart, nearest first. Cut enemies with Iaido Thrust first.

changes.name: Viper Fang
lines: Three quick poisoned stabs at the enemy in front of you. Most of their damage is poison, and every stab lays a stack of poison that keeps eating at the enemy after you move on.
Three quick poisoned stabs at the enemy in front of you. Every stab lays a stack of poison that keeps eating at the enemy.

changes.name: Moonfall
lines: Leap to the cursor and fall on the enemies there with both blades. As you sheathe them a moment later, every enemy you struck is cut again for half the damage. Movement skill: cancels the end of an attack.
Leap to the cursor and fall on the enemies there with both blades. As you sheathe them, every enemy you struck is cut again for half the damage.

changes.name: Shield Charge
lines: Charge toward the cursor behind your shield, ploughing through every enemy in your way, and burst on arrival: the blast hits everything around you. Each enemy the blast catches gives back 1.5 mana. Almost no cooldown, chain it from pack to pack.
Charge toward the cursor behind your shield, ploughing through every enemy in your way, and burst on arrival. Each enemy the blast catches gives back mana.

changes.name: Earthshatter
lines: Slam the ground so hard it splits: a fissure tears toward the cursor, hitting everything on its line. Enemies it kills leave a spike of rock that shatters a moment later, hitting those around it.
Slam the ground so hard it splits: a fissure tears toward the cursor. Enemies it kills leave a rock spike that shatters a moment later.

changes.name: Rending Slam
lines: Bring a two-handed weapon down so hard the ground rends: a shock runs out in a straight line toward the cursor, hitting every enemy on it. Your body is in the blow: 4% of your maximum life joins the weapon's base damage (Reserved Life counts). No cooldown.
Bring a two-handed weapon down so hard the ground rends: a shock runs out toward the cursor, hitting every enemy on its line. A share of your maximum life joins the base damage.

changes.name: Wheeling Axe
lines: Hurl a spinning axe toward the cursor. It cuts through every enemy in its path, then wheels back to your hand and cuts them again on the way.
Hurl a spinning axe toward the cursor. It cuts through every enemy in its path, then wheels back and cuts them again.

changes.name: Chain
lines: Chains 2 additional times, each time to another enemy (never the same one twice): strong in packs, adds nothing against a lone boss. Each jump hits 8% harder than the last, so a full chain hits the last enemies hardest. 5% less damage. A projectile that still pierces flies on first and chains once its pierce runs out (a Ballista bolt chains at its first enemy). A Spark's leaps are not projectiles: they gain the extra leaps, but each leap still loses a tenth of its damage.
Chains 2 additional times, each time to another enemy (never the same one twice): strong in packs, adds nothing against a lone boss. Each jump hits 8% harder than the last. 5% less damage.

changes.name: Added Poison
lines: Adds 1 to 6 poison damage, scaled up by the skill's gem level like its own damage. The skill's poison damage penetrates 10% poison resistance. Supports Attack and Spell skills: any hit with poison damage can poison. Supported skills get -40% to Damage over Time Multiplier, added to your other multipliers. On a minion skill its minions' hits carry it at half strength.
Adds 1 to 6 poison damage, scaled by gem level. Penetrates 10% poison resistance. -40% to Damage over Time Multiplier. Any hit with poison damage can poison; minions at half strength.

changes.name: Added Fire
lines: Spells gain 2 to 5 fire damage, scaled up by the skill's gem level like its own damage (not a summon's minions). Every skill gains 30% of its physical damage as extra fire damage: it counts the physical left after conversion, so it adds less with Lightning, Flame, Ice or Venom linked.
Spells gain 2 to 5 fire damage, scaled by gem level. Every skill gains 30% of its physical damage (after conversion) as extra fire damage.

changes.name: Elemental Focus
lines: 12% more and 25% increased Fire, Cold and Lightning damage on any skill (Physical and Poison gain nothing; Entropy implosions gain nothing extra), but the supported skill's Ignites deal 40% less damage. Conversion comes first: Physical that Flame, Ice or Zap converts gains it; the part Venom converts to Poison or Sanctified converts to Physical does not.

12% more and 25% increased Fire, Cold and Lightning damage, but the skill's Ignites deal 40% less damage. Physical and Poison gain nothing. Conversion comes first: Physical converted to an element gains it.

changes.name: Brutality
lines: 12% more physical damage and 125% increased Physical Attack damage (minions: 10% increased physical damage). Deals no elemental damage. Linked with Lightning, Flame or Ice, the converted share is lost. Heralds of Embers, Rime and Storms add nothing to it (their extra damage is elemental); Herald of Rot still does.

12% more physical damage and 125% increased Physical Attack damage (minions: 10% increased physical damage). Deals no elemental damage: converted shares are lost. Heralds of Embers, Rime and Storms add nothing; Herald of Rot still does.

changes.name: Spell Echo
lines: The spell repeats once. 15% less damage. 10% less cast speed. On a channel it adds an echo pulse every 2nd tick at 90% of the hit. An echoed curse is 20% stronger and an echoed war cry's Resolve lasts 1 second longer. Never repeats a dash, a Vow, a toggle like Orbiting Hammers or a spell a trigger casts, and a triggered cast pays none of its price (a Spark still gains its extra spark body). Repeats from a support gem and from your gear or passive tree stack, but the repeats from the smaller of the two deal 50% less damage.

The spell repeats once. 15% less damage. 10% less cast speed. An echoed curse is 20% stronger. Never repeats a dash, a Vow, a toggle or a triggered spell. Repeats from a support gem and from your gear or passive tree stack, but the repeats from the smaller of the two deal 50% less damage.

changes.name: Bloodbound
lines: The linked skill costs life instead of mana (10% more cost) and deals 7% more damage, another 10% more on its hits (not its damage over time) while you are below half your life. The classic way to keep a channel running on an empty mana pool: pair it with Siphon or Vow of Vigor.
The skill costs life instead of mana (10% more cost) and deals 7% more damage, another 10% more on hits below half life. Keeps a channel running on an empty mana pool.

changes.name: Tithe
lines: Every hit of the linked skill returns 2 mana plus 0.4% of your maximum mana (attacks) and every kill 6 mana plus 2% of your maximum mana (spells, attacks and the kills of a linked summon's minions). On a Guardian or Unique enemy, every 4% of its life the linked skill takes returns its kill mana.

Each hit of the linked skill returns 2 mana plus 0.4% of your maximum mana (attacks); each kill returns 6 plus 2% (spells, attacks, a linked summon's minions). On a Guardian or Unique enemy, each 4% of its life lost returns the kill mana.

changes.name: Woebringer
lines: The linked Woe becomes an aura around you: while sworn it reserves 24% of your mana and lays the Woe on every enemy within 4.5 metres, more with area size on the Woe (Dread grows while they stay in it). Link it to several Woes and each one is its own aura, up to the number of Woes an enemy can carry (2 + your extra Woes), each reserving its own 24%. Press the skill again to end it.

The linked Woe becomes an aura: it reserves 24% of your mana and lays the Woe on every enemy within 4.5 m (area size adds). Each linked Woe is its own aura, up to the Woes an enemy can carry (2 + extra Woes). Press again to end.

changes.name: Gather Fury
lines: Kills with the linked skill grant a Fury charge (at most one every half second). Fury: 8% increased damage and 4% increased attack and cast speed per charge, 5 charges at most. On a minion skill half of its minions' kills grant you the charge. On a Guardian or Unique enemy, every 4% of its life the linked skill takes counts as a kill.

Kills with the linked skill grant a Fury charge (once per 0.5 s): 8% increased damage and 4% increased attack and cast speed each, 5 at most. Minion kills: half grant it. On a Guardian or Unique enemy, each 4% of its life lost counts as a kill.

changes.name: Bloodlust
lines: Melee skills only. Each kill with the linked skill grants 1 stack of Bloodlust, a melee frenzy: 0.5% increased melee damage, 0.2% increased melee attack speed and 0.1% increased movement speed for each stack, up to 50 stacks. Each stack lasts 5 seconds, so keep killing to keep it up. On a minion skill half of its minions' kills grant you the stack.

Melee skills only. Each kill grants 1 Bloodlust stack: 0.5% increased melee damage, 0.2% increased melee attack speed and 0.1% increased movement speed each, up to 50, 5 s each. Minion kills: half grant it.

changes.name: Hunter's Mark
lines: Bow and Projectile skills, and minion skills. Each hit with the linked skill puts 1 Hunter's Mark on the enemy: it takes 1.7% more damage for each Mark, up to 10. The Marks fall off 3 seconds after your last hit, so keep shooting. Marks add with your War Banner, curses and every other takes more damage effect. On a minion skill it works at half strength.

Bow, Projectile and minion skills. Each hit puts 1 Hunter's Mark on the enemy: 1.7% more damage taken per Mark, up to 10. Marks fall off 3 s after your last hit. Adds with curses and every other takes-more-damage effect. Minions: half strength.

changes.name: Unravel
lines: Spell skills only. Each hit with the linked spell adds 1 Unravel stack to the enemy for the hit's element (fire, cold or lightning, each counted on its own): it takes 0.7% more damage of that element per stack, up to 25 (17.5%). Stacks build while you keep casting and last 4 seconds after your last hit, then fall off one at a time. Unravel adds with curses, Marks and every other takes more damage effect.
Spell skills only. Each hit adds 1 Unravel stack for the hit's element: the enemy takes 0.7% more damage of that element per stack, up to 25 (17.5%). Stacks last 4 seconds after your last hit.

changes.name: Woe Bearer
lines: The linked Woe is borne by your blows: every enemy your hits and your totems' hits strike takes it too (not your minions' hits, not spells a trigger casts for you), while it has room for another Woe (it never replaces one). The Woe can still be cast. Two Woe Bearers work at once, and one more for each extra Woe you can lay on an enemy.

The linked Woe is borne by your blows: every enemy your hits and your totems' hits strike takes it too, while it has room (it never replaces one). Not minion hits or triggered spells. Two Woe Bearers work at once, +1 per extra Woe.

changes.name: Spell Totem
lines: Casting places a totem where you aim (up to 9 metres away; 1 at a time, 8 seconds) that casts the spell at the nearest enemy every 0.8 seconds, whatever your cast speed. 35% less damage. Only Projectile, Chain, Nova and Skyfall spells can become a totem (not Winter Orb, Orbiting Hammers, Living Orb or any Spark). The skill's other supports apply; Spell Echo and other spell repeats echo the totem's casts, each echo dealing 20% less damage. Shares the Totem limit with your other totems (11 + bonuses). On a totem, Judgement strikes for 60% of your own cast. With Trap, the totem places the skill and Trap only adds its damage and cost. Skyfall still drops Projectile and Chain spells from the sky; Orbit, Rain and Tether lose their shape (only their numbers and cost count). Bow skills use Arrow Totem.

Casting places a totem (1 at a time, 8 seconds) that casts the spell at the nearest enemy every 0.8 seconds, whatever your cast speed. 35% less damage. Works on Projectile, Chain, Nova and Skyfall spells. Bow skills use Arrow Totem. A Totem's Judgement strikes for 60% of your own cast.

changes.name: Arrow Totem
lines: Firing places a totem where you aim (up to 9 metres; 1 at a time, 8 seconds) that fires the bow skill at the nearest enemy every 0.8 seconds instead of you. 60% less damage. Only bow skills that shoot arrows (not Rain of Arrows, Wind Vault or the Ballista). The skill's other supports apply; Multiple Totems adds totems. Arrow Totems share the Ballista limit (7 + bonuses); each count past it gives every bow engine 5% more damage instead. With Trap, the totem places the skill; Trap adds only its damage and cost. Skyfall still drops the arrows; Orbit, Rain and Tether lose their shape (only their numbers and cost count).

Firing places a totem (1 at a time, 8 seconds) that fires the bow skill at the nearest enemy every 0.8 seconds instead of you. 60% less damage. Only for bow skills that shoot arrows. Multiple Totems adds totems.

changes.name: Multiple Totems
lines: You may have 1 additional totem or ballista of the supported skill at once, and it recovers 20% faster. Gem levels never add totems; the passive tree and items can add more. 20% less damage. All your skills together stand at most 7 bow engines (Ballistas and Arrow Totems) and 11 spell totems. Totems and Ballistas of one skill share their damage: each past the first adds 50% of one's damage.

You may have 1 more totem or ballista of this skill, and it recovers 20% faster. 20% less damage. At most 7 bow engines and 11 spell totems in all. Totems and Ballistas of one skill share their damage: each past the first adds 50% of one's damage.

changes.name: Bone Guard
lines: Minions from the supported skill stay close and take on what comes at you. They have 20% more life, 50% more armour and regenerate 2.5% of their life per second. While one stands within 9 metres, you have 30% more armour plus 10 armour per level, and regenerate 1% of your life per second.
Minions have 20% more life, 50% more armour and regenerate 2.5% life per second. While one is within 9 m, you have 30% more armour plus 10 per level, and regenerate 1% life per second.

changes.name: Lightning
lines: Turns the skill to lightning: 60% of Physical, Fire and Cold damage is converted to Lightning (Poison at half: 30%). Hits shock with 30% increased effect of Shock, and its Shocks stack: 1 more Shock can sit on an enemy (each Shock is as strong as the Lightning in its own hit: a mostly Physical hit adds only a small one). A spinning attack calls lightning down from the sky onto the enemies it cuts. (Not the Zap spell: Zap is a skill gem of its own.) Physical bonuses (Added Fire, Melee Physical, Brutality) only see the 40% left physical.

Converts 60% of Physical, Fire and Cold damage to Lightning (Poison 30%). Hits shock with 30% increased effect of Shock, and 1 more Shock can stack on an enemy. A spinning attack calls lightning down onto the enemies it cuts. Physical bonuses (Added Fire, Melee Physical, Brutality) only see the 40% left physical.

changes.name: Skyfall
lines: The skill falls on its target instead of travelling: chain targets are each struck from above, bow arrows drop point-first, and a Nova blooms on its target up to 9 metres away.
