Earthshatter is the one Slam that can fall: a meteor of its element lands at the fissure's end. Area bonuses widen the blast; extra projectiles merge into one strike that grows with each. Only Projectile, Chain, Spark and Nova spells, projectile attacks (not Crescent Slash's wave) and the Ballista's volley can fall. Each enemy is struck once per use. A falling projectile uses your Skyfall damage bonuses, not your Projectile ones. With Orbit, Rain or Tether also socketed, the earlier socket shapes the skill; a losing Skyfall still adds its Skyfall tag, so Skyfall bonuses count. Through Trap and Totem gems, Projectile and Chain spells and arrows still fall. Winter Orb and Orbiting Hammers keep circling; Living Orb never falls.

The skill falls on its target from above instead of travelling. Works on Projectile, Chain, Spark and Nova spells, projectile attacks and the Ballista volley. Each enemy is struck once per use. Extra projectiles merge into one bigger strike. 20% less damage.

changes.name: Tether
lines: Each enemy hit is linked to up to 2 other enemies within 5 metres for 3 seconds (at most 6 links burn at once); linked enemies take 15% of the hit's damage per second. A skill takes one shape: with Orbit, Rain or Skyfall also socketed, the gem in the earlier socket shapes it, and with Trap or a Totem gem the links never form.

Each enemy hit is linked to up to 2 others within 5 m for 3 s (6 links at most); linked enemies take 15% of the hit's damage per second. With Orbit, Rain or Skyfall, the earlier socket shapes the skill. No links with Trap or a Totem gem.

changes.name: Channel Conduit
lines: While you channel, your linked spell casts itself at the nearest enemy every 0.5 seconds for half its mana cost, with this skill's other supports. Drop a spell on it to link it; unlinked, it casts nothing. 30% more channelling cost. Works with Cyclone and every channelled attack. Triggered spells must be on your skill bar, are never placed as totems or traps, and never trigger anything themselves.

While you channel, the spell dropped on this gem casts itself at the nearest enemy every 0.5 s for half its mana cost. 30% more channelling cost. The spell must be on your skill bar, is never a totem or trap, and triggers nothing.

changes.name: Orbit
lines: Projectiles circle you for 1.5 seconds, then each flies at the nearest enemy (arrows circle nose-first). Spells gain +1 projectile; attacks deal 50% less damage. Up to 24 circle at once. A projectile sent at an enemy already struck this cast deals 75% less damage (arrows and thrown blades 90% less: spread them over a pack). Not on Crescent Slash's wave or skills that already circle you (Orbiting Hammers, Winter Orb). Orbit keeps the skill circling even with Meteor Lore. With Rain, Tether or Skyfall, the earlier socket shapes the skill; the other adds only its numbers and cost. With Trap or a Totem gem, that gem places the skill; Orbit adds only its numbers and cost.

Projectiles circle you for 1.5 seconds, then each flies at the nearest enemy. Spells gain +1 projectile; attacks deal 50% less damage. Up to 24 circle at once. A projectile sent at an enemy already struck this cast deals 90% less damage (attacks 97% less).

changes.name: Fork
lines: Projectiles fork into two on hitting an enemy: each flies on to either side for 70% of the hit. A projectile that still pierces forks once its pierce runs out; Shuriken Fan and melee waves fork at their first enemy and fly on, and a Ballista bolt forks at its first enemy.
Projectiles fork in two on hitting an enemy, each dealing 70% of the hit. A piercing projectile forks once its pierce runs out. Shuriken Fan, melee waves and Ballista bolts fork at their first enemy.

changes.name: Rain
lines: The projectiles no longer fly: they go up and rain down on the target area, striking every enemy inside three times (four times with 4 or more projectiles). 50% less damage. A Ballista's bolts rain down on its target twice. Not on Winter Orb, Orbiting Hammers or Crescent Slash's wave: they cannot rain. A skill takes one shape: with Orbit, Tether or Skyfall also socketed, the gem in the earlier socket shapes it; with Trap or a Totem gem, that gem places the skill and Rain only adds its numbers and cost (its 50% less damage too).
The projectiles go up and rain down on the target area, striking every enemy inside three times (four times with 4 or more projectiles). 50% less damage. A Ballista's bolts rain down twice.

changes.name: Trap
lines: The skill is thrown as a trap (up to 3, 16 seconds), live the moment it lands; it goes off when an enemy comes within 4 metres and re-arms about a second later (sooner with faster re-arm). Its first strike deals 15% more damage. 12% more damage and 25% increased damage. A Trap that goes off sets off your other Traps nearby. Your Traps out at once share their damage: each Trap past the first adds 5% of a Trap's damage. Fits a bow Ballista; not Winter Orb, Orbiting Hammers, Crescent Slash, Living Orb or Storm Spark. With Spell Totem or Arrow Totem, the totem places the skill and Trap only adds its damage and cost. Skyfall still drops Projectile and Chain skills from the sky; Orbit, Rain and Tether lose their shape (only their numbers and cost count). Set off by Cast on Crit or another trigger, the skill casts at once instead of placing a Trap.

The skill is thrown as a trap (up to 3, 16 seconds) that goes off when an enemy comes within 4 metres, then re-arms after about a second. 12% more damage and 25% increased damage; its first strike deals 15% more. Traps set off other Traps nearby. Your Traps out at once share their damage: each Trap past the first adds 5% of a Trap's damage.

changes.name: Afterimage
lines: Supported melee attacks are repeated once by a ghost of the swing. 20% less damage. On a skill with several blows (Flurry, Soul Rend, Thunderfall, Twin Cuts and Viper Fang) every blow is repeated, and every cut of Thousand Cuts. Repeats from a support gem and from your gear or passive tree stack, but the repeats from the smaller of the two deal 50% less damage. If your gear or tree already repeats the skill, this gem's less damage hits only its own repeats.

Supported melee attacks are repeated once by a ghost of the swing. 20% less damage. Multi-blow skills repeat every blow. Repeats from a support gem and from your gear or passive tree stack, but the repeats from the smaller of the two deal 50% less damage.

changes.name: Stormfrost
lines: 60% increased Freeze duration and Crack damage

changes.name: Repeat
lines: Bow skills fire 1 more time, a moment later (a Ballista fires each bolt twice). Channelled skills strike 1 more time inside each pulse. 45% less damage. Repeats from a support gem and from your gear or passive tree stack, but the repeats from the smaller of the two deal 50% less damage. If your gear or tree already repeats the skill, only this gem's own repeats take the full 45% less; the hit and the gear repeats take about 8% less.

Bow skills fire 1 more time, a moment later (a Ballista fires each bolt twice). Channelled skills strike 1 more time inside each pulse. 45% less damage. Repeats from a support gem and from your gear or passive tree stack, but the repeats from the smaller of the two deal 50% less damage.

changes.name: Cast on Crit
lines:
What it does depends on the skill it sits in.
In a spell with nothing linked: the spell casts itself at the enemy struck when one of your attacks lands a critical hit, for its full mana cost. All such spells take turns on one clock: at most one cast every 0.3 seconds.
In an attack with nothing linked: the attack strikes by itself when another of your attacks lands a critical hit. All such attacks share one clock of 0.75 seconds and deal 58% less damage in all (a Rain drops every wave, each at its share of the damage; Repeat, Afterimage and Multistrike never repeat it). Blade Vortex fills and renews its ring this way. In a channelled attack, its own critical hits release a crit pulse, its hit again around it, on that same clock.
With a spell linked (any skill that hits): its critical hits cast that spell, for its full mana cost.
Only attacks' critical hits set off the unlinked ones; a spell's critical hits cast its own link and also give the unlinked ones their turn. All your Cast on Crit share one 0.15 second clock, so one critical hit casts one skill. Triggered skills deal 25% less damage, must be on your skill bar and never trigger anything. It never spends your last 20% of mana. Only spells can be linked. Movement skills, Sheathe, channelled spells, Heralds, Vows and auras never cast or strike by themselves. In a totem or ballista it casts only its own link, at most once per second.

Your critical hits trigger this skill. A linked spell casts on your skill's crits; an unlinked spell casts itself (one cast per 0.3 seconds); an unlinked attack strikes again on another attack's crit (one strike per 0.75 seconds, 58% less damage in all). All your Cast on Crit share one 0.15 second clock. Triggered skills deal 25% less damage, must be on your skill bar and never spend your last 20% of mana. Movement, channelled, summon, totem and aura skills are never triggered.

changes.name: Cast when Hit
lines: Each time you have taken damage equal to 10% of your maximum life, the spell this is socketed in casts itself at the attacker, at most once every 0.5 seconds, for 50% of its mana cost. The triggered spell deals 10% less damage. In an attack, or to cast another spell, drop a spell on its link. One link per skill. Triggered spells must be on your skill bar, are never placed as totems or traps, and never trigger anything themselves. Fits totems and ballistas too: a totem's trigger fires at most once per second.

Each time you take damage equal to 10% of your maximum life, the linked spell casts at the attacker (once per 0.5 seconds, 50% of its mana cost, never your last 20% of mana). It deals 10% less damage. One link per skill. Movement, channelled, summon, totem and aura skills are never triggered.

changes.name: Cast on Minion Death
lines: When a minion from this skill dies, your linked spell casts itself at the enemy nearest to where it fell, at most once per second, for 50% of its mana cost and with this skill's other supports. The linked spell deals 10% less damage. Drop a spell on it to link it; unlinked, it casts nothing. One link per skill: the first linking support socketed works. Triggered spells must be on your skill bar, are never placed as totems or traps, and never trigger anything themselves.

When a minion from this skill dies, the linked spell casts itself at the enemy nearest to where it fell, at most once per second, for 50% of its mana cost, never your last 20% of mana. The spell deals 10% less damage. Drop a spell on it to link it. One link per skill.

changes.name: Rend
lines: Physical hits of this skill have a 50% chance to cause Bleeding: 50% of the hit's physical damage each second for 4 seconds (the strongest bleed holds; 50% more while the enemy moves). 12% more Bleeding damage and 100% increased Bleeding damage. A new bleed on a bleeding enemy deepens it 6%, up to 6 times. A Slam or a crit cashes 50% of the next 4 seconds of bleed at once. On a minion skill it works at half strength.

Physical hits have a 50% chance to cause Bleeding: 40% of the hit's physical damage per second for 4 s (50% more while the enemy moves). 12% more and 100% increased Bleeding damage. Slams and crits cash 50% of the next 4 s at once.

changes.name: Deep Wounds
lines: +40% to Damage over Time Multiplier for this skill, added to your other multipliers: its Ignites, Poisons and Bleeding deal more. Hits are unchanged. A Slam or a crit cashes 50% of the next 4 seconds of bleed at once. On a minion skill it works at half strength.

+40% to Damage over Time Multiplier for this skill: its Ignites, Poisons and Bleeding deal more. Hits are unchanged. Slams and crits cash 50% of the next 4 s of bleed at once. Minion skills at half strength.

changes.name: Gathering Storm
lines: This skill's Shocks stack: 2 more Shocks can sit on an enemy (3 in all), adding up to at most 75% more damage taken (each Shock is as strong as the Lightning in its own hit: a mostly Physical hit adds only a small one). +25% chance to Shock with Lightning hits. On a minion skill it works at half strength.

Shocks from this skill stack: 2 more Shocks on an enemy (3 in all), up to 75% more damage taken. Each Shock scales with the Lightning in its hit. +25% chance to Shock with Lightning hits. Minion skills at half strength.

changes.name: Contagious Flame
lines: When an enemy this skill ignited dies, its Ignite spreads (100% chance) to enemies within 4.5 metres. While it burns, every second it also passes its Ignite to the nearest enemy within 3 metres that burns less. +15% chance to Ignite with Fire hits. On a minion skill it works at half strength.

When an enemy this skill ignited dies, its Ignite spreads to enemies within 4.5 m. While burning, it also passes its Ignite each second to the nearest enemy within 3 m. +15% chance to Ignite with Fire hits. Minion skills at half strength.

changes.name: Shatter
lines: Chilled or Frozen enemies this skill kills shatter: 12% of their maximum Life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as Cold damage to enemies within 3.5 metres, chilling them, and an enemy the burst kills shatters in turn. 20% increased effect of Chill. On a minion skill it works at half strength.

Chilled or Frozen enemies this skill kills shatter: 12% of their maximum Life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as Cold damage to enemies within 3.5 m, chilling them; an enemy the burst kills shatters in turn. 20% increased effect of Chill. Minions: half strength.

changes.name: Multistrike
lines: The melee attack strikes 3 times: it repeats 2 more times and every strike deals 44% of the damage (56% less). On a skill with several blows (Flurry, Soul Rend, Thunderfall, Twin Cuts and Viper Fang) every blow is repeated, and every cut of Thousand Cuts. Works on minions: each of their blows strikes 2 more times. Repeats from a support gem and from your gear or passive tree stack, but the repeats from the smaller of the two deal 50% less damage. If your gear or tree already repeats the skill, this gem's less damage hits only its own repeats.

The melee attack strikes 3 times: it repeats 2 more times, and every strike deals 44% of the damage (56% less). Multi-blow skills repeat every blow. On a minion skill, each of its blows strikes 2 more times. Repeats from a support gem and from your gear or passive tree stack, but the repeats from the smaller of the two deal 50% less damage.

changes.name: Maim
lines: Hits Maim the enemy for 4 seconds: it moves 30% slower and takes 10% more Physical damage from hits by you, your minions and your allies (not from Bleed). 8% more Physical damage. Works on minions. Only the Physical part counts: damage converted to an element (Lightning, Flame, Ice or Venom linked) gains nothing from Maim.

Hits Maim the enemy for 4 s: it moves 30% slower and takes 10% more Physical damage from hits by you, your minions and your allies (not Bleed). 8% more Physical damage. Only Physical counts: converted damage gains nothing.

changes.name: Executioner
lines: The physical finisher: 35% more damage against enemies below half their life on the physical part of a hit (14% on its fire, cold, lightning and poison), and hits kill enemies left below 10% of their life (Guardians too). Hits only: Bleed, Poison and Ignite do not gain the more damage. Works with bows and on minions.

35% more damage to enemies below half life on the physical part of a hit (14% on fire, cold, lightning, poison); hits kill enemies left below 10% life (Guardians too). Hits only, not Bleed, Poison or Ignite. Works with bows and minions.

changes.name: Vicious Projectiles
lines: 12% more Physical damage with projectiles and 100% increased Physical damage with projectile attacks, 10% less attack speed. Only the Physical part counts: it adds nothing to damage converted to an element (Lightning, Flame, Ice or Venom linked). On a summon it fits minions that shoot, at half strength.

12% more Physical damage with projectiles and 100% increased Physical damage with projectile attacks, 10% less attack speed. Only the Physical part counts, so a conversion support takes it away. Minions that shoot at half strength.

changes.name: Chain Detonation
lines: Supports skills thrown as Traps. A Trap that goes off sets off your other Traps nearby, one after another. Traps set each other off at 100% increased distance, and each Trap further down the chain deals 8% more damage. +1 to the maximum number of Traps.
Supports Traps. A Trap that goes off sets off your other Traps nearby in a chain, at 100% increased distance. Each Trap further down the chain deals 8% more damage. +1 maximum Traps.

changes.name: Volatile Dead
lines: Minions from the supported skill explode where they fall: when killed, when their time runs out, or when a new cast replaces them past your limit. Each blast deals Fire damage equal to 80% of its hit damage in 3 metres, wider with area of effect. Recast at your limit to detonate your oldest minions.

Minions explode where they fall: killed, expired, or replaced past your limit. Each blast deals Fire damage in 3 m equal to 80% of its hit damage. Recast at your limit to detonate your oldest minions.

changes.name: Funeral Pyre
lines: Enemies killed by the supported skill's hits burst into flame where they fall, dealing Fire damage in 2.5 metres equal to 15% of their maximum Life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life). The burst is not the skill's hit, so what it kills does not burst again.

Enemies killed by the skill's hits burst into flame, dealing Fire damage in 2.5 m equal to 15% of their maximum Life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most). The burst is not a hit, so it never chains.

changes.name: Dawnbringer
lines: Every third hit of the linked Holy attack calls a pillar of dawn on the enemy, dealing 120% of the hit as Fire damage (at most once a second on the same enemy). For Holy Slash, Hallowed Slam, Holy Charge and Shield Throw; it stacks with the Dawnward Bulwark and Dawnmarch, each counts its own hits.
Every third hit of the linked Holy attack calls a pillar of dawn, dealing 120% of the hit as Fire damage (once per second per enemy). For Holy Slash, Hallowed Slam, Holy Charge and Shield Throw.

changes.name: Grave Conscription
lines: Enemies killed by the linked attack have a 25% chance to rise as one of your Zombies while you have fewer than 4 (at most once every half second). Your minion damage and life apply to them, and if you also have Raise Zombie, its minion supports do too. Any attack build can grow a small horde.
Enemies killed by the linked attack have a 25% chance to rise as your Zombie while you have fewer than 4 (once per 0.5 s). Your minion damage and life apply to them.

changes.name: Venom Bloom
lines: Every fourth hit of the linked Poison attack bursts in venom: enemies within 2.5 metres take 45% of the hit as Poison damage (at most once every 0.2 seconds, each enemy at most once every 0.5 seconds). For Gravereap, Soul Rend and Marrow Lance: a pack clear for poison melee.

Every fourth hit of the linked Poison attack bursts in venom: enemies within 2.5 m take 45% of the hit as Poison damage, each enemy at most once every 0.5 seconds. For Gravereap, Soul Rend and Marrow Lance.

changes.name: Sanctifying Light
lines: Turns the linked Holy attack to holy light: 60% of its Fire, Cold and Lightning damage is converted to Physical (Poison at half: 30%), so added elemental damage from your gear feeds your Physical bonuses, and it deals 8% more Physical damage and 15% increased Physical damage. The Paladin's answer to Zap, Flame, Ice and Venom; pairs with Brutality.

Holy attacks: 60% of Fire, Cold and Lightning damage converts to Physical (Poison 30%), so added elemental damage feeds your Physical bonuses. 8% more Physical damage and 15% increased Physical damage. Pairs with Brutality.

changes.name: Whirling Host
lines: The linked Orbit skill adds one more blade or hammer with each cast and its ring holds one more (Blade Vortex 9 instead of 8, Orbiting Hammers 4 instead of 3), each dealing 15% less damage. A wider, fuller ring that fills faster and catches more of the pack.
The linked Orbit skill adds one more blade or hammer per cast and its ring holds one more (Blade Vortex 9, Orbiting Hammers 4), each dealing 15% less damage.

changes.name: Rampart Strike
lines: The linked Shield attack deals 0.8% more damage for every 1% chance to block you have (at 50% block: 40% more, at 75%: 60% more). It adds into the same damage engine as the passive tree's lines that pay your defences. Shield Charge, Holy Charge and Shield Throw: the block you build to live now hits back.
The linked Shield attack deals 0.8% more damage per 1% chance to block you have (50% block: 40% more). For Shield Charge, Holy Charge and Shield Throw.

changes.name: Spreading Pyre
lines: The linked corpse skill's fire leaps on to 3 more fresh corpses, one after another, each within the burst's radius of the last. Each leap bursts for its own corpse's life at 70% of the burst before it (Pyre Burst at gem 20: 10% of the slain's life, then 7%, then 4.9%, then 3.4%). Corpses its own fire makes carry it on: a pack goes up like kindling.

The linked corpse skill's fire leaps to 3 more fresh corpses, each within the burst's radius of the last, bursting at 70% of the one before (Pyre Burst at gem 20: 10%, 7%, 4.9%, 3.4% of the slain's life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life)). Corpses its fire makes carry it on.

changes.name: Defiant Roar
lines: The linked war cry also grants a Fury charge for each Resolve charge it grants (Jarl's Roar into 3 enemies: 3 Resolve and 3 Fury), and that Resolve lasts 50% longer (10 s to 15 s). Fury: 8% increased damage and 4% increased attack and cast speed each, 5 charges at most. The roar that holds the line now pays you to stand in it.

The linked war cry also grants a Fury charge for each Resolve charge, and Resolve lasts 50% longer (10 s to 15 s). Fury: 8% increased damage and 4% increased attack and cast speed each, 5 charges at most.

changes.name: Rallying Standard
lines: The linked War Banner lands with 5 Valour already raised, keeps all of its Valour when you move it (not half), and holds up to 10 more (20 to 30). Each Valour is 0.5% more damage taken by enemies near it: a banner you can carry from pack to pack and plant straight into a Guardian fight.
The linked War Banner lands with 5 Valour, keeps all of its Valour when moved (not half), and holds 10 more (30). Each Valour is 0.5% more damage taken by enemies near it.

changes.name: Focused Volley
lines: The linked bow skill fires 1 more arrow, and all its arrows fly on one line at your target, each with its own hit, so one enemy can take every arrow. Each arrow after the first deals 35% of the one before it (2 arrows: 100% + 35%; 4 arrows: 100% + 35% + 12% + 4%), and the skill deals 15% less damage. A Guardian killer: you give up the spread. It works on arrows you shoot yourself and on the bolts of your Ballista or Arrow Totem (not a trap or rain).

The linked bow skill fires 1 more arrow, and all its arrows fly on one line at your target. Each arrow after the first deals 35% of the one before it. 15% less damage. A Guardian killer: you give up the spread.

changes.name: Killer Instinct
lines: Your linked minions strike for the throat: +4% to their base critical strike chance, 100% increased critical strike chance and +25% to critical strike multiplier. The crit support minion builds never had: your tree's minion and critical strike lines now have something to scale.
Linked minions gain +2% base critical strike chance, 100% increased critical strike chance and +20% to critical strike multiplier.

changes.name: Ironclad Fury
lines: The linked skill deals 0.25% more damage per 1,000 Armour you have. Every 1,000 counts in full: at 40,000 Armour, 10% more. It adds into the same damage engine as the passive tree's lines that pay your defences. Any attack or spell, totems and traps too.
The linked skill deals 0.25% more damage per 1,000 Armour you have (40,000 Armour: 10% more). Any attack or spell, totems and traps too.

changes.name: Kindling
lines: Spells only. Each kill with the linked spell grants 1 stack of Kindling: 0.5% increased spell damage and 0.2% increased cast speed for each stack, up to 50 stacks. Each stack lasts 5 seconds, so keep killing to keep it up. On a Guardian, every 4% of its life the spell takes counts as a kill. Grave Call kills nothing itself, so it never gains Kindling.
Spells only. Each kill with the linked spell grants 1 stack of Kindling: 0.5% increased spell damage and 0.2% increased cast speed per stack, up to 50 stacks. Each stack lasts 5 seconds.

changes.name: Fervent Vow
lines: Every line of the linked Vow gets another 15% of its base value while it is sworn, its Vowbreak too. Every Vow gem's own text already includes its built-in 15% (patch 82): Vow of Iron's 50.6% more Armour at gem level 20 becomes 57.2% with this gem. Heralds grow with Herald Effect instead.
Every line of the linked Vow gets another 15% of its base value while sworn, its Vowbreak too (Vow of Iron at gem level 20: 50.6% to 57.2% more Armour). Heralds grow with Herald Effect.

changes.name: Arc Conduit
lines: When this skill hits a Shocked enemy, lightning arcs from it to the 2 nearest other Shocked enemies within 8 metres, each taking 40% of the hit. An arc never arcs again, and each enemy arcs at most twice a second. +20% chance to Shock with Lightning hits. Shock the pack with any skill and every hit of this one runs through it: a clear pick that adds nothing against a lone Guardian.

When this skill hits a Shocked enemy, lightning arcs to the 2 nearest other Shocked enemies within 8 m for 40% of the hit (twice per second per enemy, no re-arcing). +20% chance to Shock with Lightning hits.

changes.name: Frostbreak
lines: Hits of this skill deal 50% more damage to a Brittle Guardian or boss (the 5.5 seconds after its freeze bar fills). Hits on a Chilled or Frozen enemy break off shards: 25% of the hit as Cold damage to up to 6 enemies within 3 metres (each enemy sheds shards at most twice a second). Fill the freeze bar with your cold skill, then break it with this one.

Hits deal 50% more damage to a Brittle Guardian or boss (5.5 s after its freeze bar fills). Hits on a Chilled or Frozen enemy shed shards: 25% of the hit as Cold damage to up to 6 enemies within 3 m (twice a second per enemy).

changes.name: Wildfire
lines: When this skill hits a Burning enemy, flames leap from it to the 2 nearest enemies within 5 metres that are not burning: each takes 30% of the hit as Fire damage and is always Ignited by it. Each enemy throws flames at most twice a second. +15% chance to Ignite with Fire hits. Contagious Flame spreads Ignite when an enemy dies; Wildfire spreads it on every hit.

When this skill hits a Burning enemy, flames leap to the 2 nearest enemies within 5 m that are not burning: each takes 30% of the hit as Fire damage and is always Ignited (twice a second per enemy). +15% chance to Ignite with Fire hits.

changes.name: Haemorrhage
lines: Hits of this skill deal 40% more damage to an enemy Bleeding from another of your skills. Its own bleeds do not count. A wound another of your skills laid counts for as long as it lasts, even when this skill's own bleed is the stronger one. Open with a bleed (Rend on the quick skill), then tear it with this one (a Slam on a deep wound). Nothing changes on enemies that do not bleed.
Hits of this skill deal 40% more damage to an enemy Bleeding from another of your skills (its own bleed does not count). Open with a bleed, then tear it with this.

changes.name: Lone Herald
lines: The linked Herald's extra damage and its kill effect are 15% stronger for each other Herald you have not sworn. Alone it is 60% stronger: at gem level 20 its 19.5% of hit damage as extra becomes 31.2%, and Herald of Embers' burst 12% of the slain enemy's maximum Life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) becomes 19.2%. With every Herald sworn it adds nothing. The reservation the other Heralds would take is yours to spend on Vows, Woes or minions.

The linked Herald's extra damage and kill effect are 15% stronger for each other Herald you have not sworn. Alone it is 60% stronger. With every Herald sworn it adds nothing. The reservation the other Heralds would take is yours to spend.

changes.name: Woeweaver
lines: Hits of this skill deal 25% more damage to an enemy that bears exactly one Woe, 10% more if it bears two, and no more with three or more. One Woe woven into your main skill instead of a ring of them: the reservation you keep is yours for Vows, Heralds or minions.
Hits of this skill deal 25% more damage to an enemy bearing exactly one Woe, 10% more with two, none more with three or more.

changes.name: Quarry Command
lines: The linked minions hunt your quarry: the last enemy you hit yourself in the last 6 seconds, within 15 metres. They turn on it and deal 30% more damage to it, and 30% less to every other enemy while you have a quarry. Strike the Guardian or the rare with your own skill and the pack follows your lead.
Linked minions hunt your quarry: the last enemy you hit yourself in 6 s, within 15 m. They deal 30% more damage to it and 30% less to every other enemy while you have a quarry.

changes.name: Skyward Oath
lines: Critical strikes of the linked Melee attack call down 2 Sky Swords on the enemy struck, each dealing 24% of that critical hit (at most once a second). The swords fall within 2.5 metres of the enemy, are not hits of the attack and trigger nothing themselves. For any blade that crits: a clean cut, and the sky signs it.

Critical strikes of the linked Melee attack call down 2 Sky Swords on the enemy, each dealing 24% of that critical hit (once a second), within 2.5 m. They are not hits of the attack and trigger nothing.

changes.name: Stormhound Pact
lines: Critical strikes of the linked Lightning spell loose a Storm Wolf for 4 seconds (at most 2 wolves, at most one new wolf a second). Each wolf leaps at an enemy within 8 metres every 0.8 seconds for 16% of that critical hit as Lightning damage. At least a quarter of the spell's hit must be Lightning, its own or converted. The wolves are not casts of the spell and trigger nothing themselves. A caster's own pack.

Critical strikes of the linked Lightning spell loose a Storm Wolf for 4 seconds (at most 2 wolves). Each wolf leaps at an enemy within 8 metres every 0.8 seconds for 16% of that critical hit as Lightning damage.

changes.name: Pale Apprentices
lines: Enemies killed by the linked spell have a 20% chance to rise as one of your Skeletal Mages while you have fewer than 3 raised this way (at most once every half second). Your minion damage and life apply to them, and if you also have Summon Skeletal Mage, its minion supports do too (Pale Apprentices links to a spell, not to Summon Skeletal Mage itself). Any caster can keep a few students.

Enemies the linked spell kills have a 20% chance to rise as one of your Skeletal Mages (up to 3 this way, once per 0.5 s). Your minion damage and life apply; so do the minion supports of Summon Skeletal Mage.

changes.name: Rimewake
lines: The linked Movement skill ends in a burst of frost: enemies within 3 metres of the target take 25% of the skill's hit as Cold damage (at most once every half second), and your Chill has 20% increased effect with this skill. For Leap Slam, Moonfall, Iaido Thrust, Shield Charge, Holy Charge, Wind Vault and the dashes: arrive, and the pack is already cold for Shatter.

The linked Movement skill ends in a frost burst: enemies within 3 m of the target take 25% of the hit as Cold damage (once per 0.5 s), and your Chill has 20% increased effect with it. Arrive, and the pack is cold for Shatter.

changes.name: Gravesown
lines: While you channel the supported skill, a Husk claws up from the ground within 3 metres of you every 0.6 to 0.8 seconds (faster at higher Rupture Levels), at most 3 of your Husks at once. On a skill that is not channelled, each enemy it hits has a 10% chance to leave a Husk at its feet. A Husk is a fresh corpse for 6 seconds that your corpse skills can burst or consume. It gives no experience or loot, and triggered casts never raise one.
While you channel the skill, a Husk claws up within 3 m every 0.6 to 0.8 s (at most 3). Otherwise 10% chance per enemy hit to leave one. A Husk is a fresh corpse for 6 s, with no experience or loot.

changes.name: Kindled Remains
lines: Each pulse of the supported channelled skill, or each hit of another supported skill (at most 4 times a second), sets off one fresh corpse within 2.5 metres of you or of the enemy struck. It bursts as the skill's damage type (Physical if none) in 2 metres for a share of the corpse's life, set per Rupture Level band so a burst keeps pace with the monsters there: 13% below RL 50, 5% at RL 50-99 (corpses there carry far more life), 54% at RL 100-149, 99% at RL 150-199 and 360% from RL 200 (corpse life stops growing at RL 150). The burst cannot crit and never sets off this support again.

Each pulse or hit (at most 4 times a second) sets off a fresh corpse within 2.5 m. It bursts in 2 m as the skill's damage type for a share of the corpse's life (13% below Rupture Level 50, 5% at 50-99, 54% at 100-149, 99% at 150-199, 360% from 200). Cannot crit.

changes.name: Chaos
lines: 40% of this skill's hit damage is laid on the enemy as Entropy instead of striking. Entropy implodes 3 seconds after it is first laid as Chaos damage, 50% more, ignoring Armour and elemental Resistance. A dying enemy bursts 30% of its Entropy onto enemies within 3 metres. Entropy causes no Ailments or Leech.

40% of this skill's hit damage is laid on the enemy as Entropy. It implodes 3 s later as Chaos damage, 25% more, ignoring Armour and elemental Resistance. A dying enemy bursts 30% of its Entropy onto enemies within 3 m. No Ailments or Leech.

Hero damage is cut to 80% at every level (this came with patch 82, which this build includes).
Levels past +5 from gear add less than before, for attacks, spells and minions.
Lightning Arrow about 35% stronger. The Mage's nine core spells gain 15% at gem level 20, rising to 45% at 24. Necromancer minions deal about 20% more.
Hallowed Slam, Orbiting Hammers and Ground Slam are trimmed. Drain Life, Death Coil and the Grave Golem lose 15 to 18%, Venom Spark and Caustic skills 7 to 10%.
Unravel: each spell hit makes the enemy take a little more damage of that element, up to 25 stacks.
Ballistas 7, Totems 11, army 28. Traps have a top limit of 10.
Chill makes enemies take more per stack (0.7%, was 0.5%). Kindle is 30% (was 25%).

17 new uniques and many changed ones (Red Harvest halved, Clarion's Herald boost 25%). Idol lines: general damage lines are halved, build-specific lines are 30% stronger. A Riven line at tier 0 is never below tier 1.
Guardians from Rupture Level 150 to 200 have less life. Past 200, monster life doubles every 50 Riven Tiers.
Online heroes were wiped; the old ones moved to Offline.
Every debuff on an enemy now counts. Debuffs of the same kind add together, different kinds multiply (curses, marks, Shock, vulnerability are each a kind), each kind with its own cap.

Iaido Thrust, Blade Vortex and Shuriken Fan about 20% at gem level 20. Ground Slam up to 19% at middle gem levels. Judgement about 20% from gem level 10. Pyre of Faith and Shield Throw are stronger on low gems.
Lightning Arrow: its early bonus is gone by gem level 14 and it deals about 11% less on high gems.

Venom Spark up to 28% and Drain Life and Death Coil up to 18% more from gem level 20. Minions deal 9 to 15% more and hit up to 5 enemies. Three points in Grave Lore add a Skeleton, Skeletal Mage or Zombie.
A Tear keeps 40% of each burst as bonus damage. Ground effects (slam cracks, Pyre, Void) no longer cash in a Tear.
Past the cast speed cap, extra cast speed becomes damage for channelled and standing spells.
+skill level lines on Riven items at tier 0 give their full roll again. On Idols of item level 84 and up, general damage lines roll at 70%.
Second Battery and Circle of Stones give +1 totem again.

Riven Tiers start gently (tier 1, 2, 3 play like Rupture Level 201, 202, 203). Levels 150 to 200 take about half again as long. Low Guardians (level 7 to 30) have less life. Levelling from 67 to 100 is slower.

Hoarfrost Volley about doubles at gem level 20. Judgement is about 25% stronger from gem level 10, Pyre of Faith about 20% at gem level 20. Chain Lightning is much stronger early (about 50%) and a little weaker at gem level 20.
Lightning Arrow loses up to 15% from gem level 18.
Skeletal Mages deal about 14% more, Skeletons 11%, Zombies 8%.
Focused Volley: each next arrow deals 40% of the one before (was 60%). Orbit: attacks lose 50% (was 65%). Four new supports.
Thousand Feathers and the bow Dexterity node now pay out for every projectile attack, not only bows.
The notables that turn block chance into damage are about half again as strong.

Five new uniques. New weapon suffix: Poison Penetration (double on two-handers). Seven new prefixes for 2x2 Idols, plus +1 Trap and +1 Spark Idol lines. A Riven line at tier 0 now always beats tier 1.
Stepping out of a Guardian's arena makes you take 25% more damage for 2.5 seconds. Magic monsters have 20 to 25% more life.

Ascension 2.0 replaces the old Dragonling tree. Points now come from the Dragon Ruptures you have reached (Rupture Level 10 up to 200), not from levels. Your old tree is refunded the first time you log in.
Chance to Bleed, Poison or Ignite above 100% is no longer wasted: the part above 100% becomes increased damage for that ailment.
A skill turned to another element (by a support or an item) now counts as a skill of that element for lines that ask for one.

Judgement and Storm Spark deal about twice the damage at high gem levels. Marrow Lance is about 31% stronger at every level, Shuriken Fan about 27%, Cyclone about 15% and Iaido Thrust about 12% at high levels. Death Coil (about 72%) and Venom Spark (about 43%) are stronger on low gems. Frost Nova, Chain Lightning and the Sparks reach their late damage at lower gem levels. Skeletal Mages gain more damage per level. Winter Orb lasts 10 seconds (was 6).
Lightning Arrow deals about 15% less at high gem levels.
Gravefeast (a Necromancer skill that strengthens your minions), the supports Gravesown and Kindled Remains, the unique The Falling Feather, 70 new passive nodes and a set of new class notables.
Sentence of Chains: enemies take 16% more Physical damage (was 12%). Sentence of Exposure: 11% more Fire, Cold and Lightning (was 8%).
Every Golem you have out now gives its blessing, not only one.
Many small nodes near the class starts also give 3% increased maximum Life, some 6% increased maximum Energy Shield too. Runic Ward is 64% Energy Shield (was 53%).
Elemental Overload is now Sworn Surge (and gives 50% more Elemental damage, was 35%), Chain Reaction is Leaping Ruin, Blood Magic is Heartspend, Spellblade is Edgecaster. They work as before.
Guardians have a break bar, and Riven Tiers past Rupture Level 200 follow a new life curve.

Vows on a red cost more red runes: the 2nd Vow 3 (was 2), the 3rd 6 (was 4), then 9, 12 and 15 for the 4th to 6th (was 6, 8 and 10). The 1st Vow still takes one Tier V+ rune, and each Vow still costs 3 Core Embers.
Past Rupture Level 100, enemies resist Fire, Cold and Lightning a little more: 0.05% per Rupture Level, up to 10%.
Bastion's Reckoning now counts only your best defence, not all of them added up.
Lightning Arrow hits about 25% harder. Sure Strike can no longer crit but gets 120% more Bleeding damage. Cast on Crit now fires on spell crits too.
Three new Guardians (Shellback Tyrant, Drowned Captain, Weaver Queen) with their signature runes, about 50 new reds, and the Chaos support (switched off in the game in this build).

New: Entropy. Chaos supports, keystones and some reds lay part of each hit on the enemy as Entropy instead of striking. About 3 seconds later it implodes as Chaos damage that ignores Armour and elemental resistance. An enemy that dies carrying Entropy bursts it onto the pack. New: the Chaos support and five more chaos supports, one chaos keystone per class, Woe of Entropy (more Chaos damage taken), chaos reds and Oathwords.

Grave, Flame, Ice, Storm and Venom Golem are now five separate gems. Each has its own blessing, and supports no longer change it. The Grave Golem's blessing is now life regeneration and soaking part of your hits, not damage. Only one golem stands at a time; use the gem again to make it leap.

Only one tree node per defence still turns it into damage: Bastion's Reckoning (Armour, now 0.8% per 1,000), Fleet Shadow (Evasion), Swift Ward (Energy Shield), Oathstone Body (Life) and Dawnmarch (Block). 16 other nodes lost that line and refund their points. Ironclad Fury pays for Armour only.

At gem level 20 and up: Death Coil about 65% stronger, Venom Spark about 30-50%, Winter Orb, Rime Spark, Ember Bolt and Fuse Arrow stronger still at gem 24, Lightning Arrow, Pyre of Faith, Cyclone, Thousand Cuts and Flurry about 25-30%, Hoarfrost Volley and Glacial Shards about 12%. Down: Judgement deals about 46% less at high gem levels, Storm Brand about 18% less, and Shuriken Fan about 19% less.
Tear now cashes at most 4 seconds of a Bleed. Sure Strike's Bleeding bonus is 57% more (was 120%). Heralds count a converted hit once, and Skyfall counts increased area once.
Many Oath Mastery lines doubled: Oath of Fury's Melee damage and Oath of the Storm's shock and crit lines, for example.

87 reds now use lines the game already knows (Sentences, Fury, Woes, item Oaths, Dragonling relics). Owned copies update when you log in. Seven of them got weaker, among them The Regent's Thirst, Stormstring and Oathbreaker. 16 new endgame reds, and old lines return on Primal copies. Reds drop from monster level 35 now (was 10).
Guardian life was retuned. Arena walls fall when the Guardian dies.

The public game data went from build 90 straight to 92, so the lists below hold Patch 91 (25 Nov) and Patch 92 (26 Nov) together. The lines here say which patch each change came with, from the developer's notes.

Ground Slam deals half as much. Ember Spark about 23% less at gem 20 and up. All five Golems deal 2.5 times as much. At gem 20: Wayward Orb and Unholy Void x4, Ancestral Warrior x3.8, Storm Whirl x2.9, Marrow Lance x1.67, Shield Charge x1.5, Thunderfall x1.4. Early gems: Orbiting Hammers x2.3, Shield Charge x2, Drain Life x1.6. Pyre of Faith hits about 44% less below gem 18 (gem 20 unchanged) and its burn no longer ignites.

Haemorrhage 15% more (was 25%). Rampart Strike 0.3% more per 1% block (was 0.8%). Arcane Lattice gives 15% increased Totem damage in place of +1 Totem. Starcaller's Staff: increased Damage halved, +1 Skyfall level (was +2). Bina's Spotter's Helm ramp 25% (was 50%; Patch 92 cut it again).

All Spark kinds now share one limit: a cast past it fades the oldest Spark of any kind. One kind alone is unchanged. Each kind of minion past the second makes every kind reserve 25% more mana. Legion of One raises one kind of minion per area.

Kindled Remains bursts a corpse for 25.2% of its life at Rupture Level 50-99 and 28.8% from 100, grown by the skill's damage, up to 3 corpses at once (the old shares ran from 5% to 360%). Pyre Saint 8.4% at 50-99. Increased Corpse damage now works on corpse bursts. New Necromancer notables Funeral Ash and Pyre Procession.

Energy Shield wards big elemental hits at 50% of its maximum (was 25%), and a new suffix gives faster Energy Shield recharge. Guardian kills at Rupture Level 105, 115, 125, 135 and 145 give one passive point each. 18 new shortcut links on the passive tree. A new Guardian, The Oathsmith. New Cube recipes: Family Infusing and Gear Fusing; Family Imbuing needs 1 jewel.
Monsters at Rupture Level 200 and in every Riven Tier have 10% less life and deal 5% less damage, Guardians included.
At gem 20: Cyclone x4.3, Death Coil x3.5, Rending Slam x3.5 (from gem 16), Storm Whirl x3.1 (on top of Patch 91's lift), Drain Life x3, Caustic Arrow x2.3, Holy Elemental x2.

Dual wielding gives 25% more attack speed (was 10%). Heralds give 15% at gem 20 (was 19.5%; Rot and Steel 13.5%), with a new Resonance: 12% stronger for each other sworn Herald or Woe aura of the same element. The Chaos support's Entropy pays its full share. Ailment chance over 100% turns into half as much ailment damage as before.
Patch 92: cuts to the strongest builds

Bina's Spotter's Helm ramp 10% (was 25%). The Long Battery 2% more per Ballista or Totem (was 4%). Gravebloom's minion damage 102 (was 251). Glass Cannon's minion damage 12% more (was 25%); Pyre Covenant and Marrow Lord minions 6% less. Entropy lines about halved: Pact of Ruin, Entropic Focus, Gathering Dark, Quarry's Debt, Ruin Fletching, Blood Ledger's Slam line. The Blackbile Censer and Seal rolls about halved.
Patch 92: Riven lines and the Forge

Riven gem level lines cost 4 Rivenstones and drop 4 times rarer. Guardians drop Red Shards: 6 shards, a plain base and 3 Oathsteel make that red at the Forge. Red Forge makes a red from a Forgeheart and materials. Rivenhold cuts a Dwarven Rune Socket into a rare ring, belt or boots for 24 Rivenstones.

Mostly lifts at low gem levels. 15% more: Storm Whirl (gem 1-8), Zap (1-10), Piercing Shot and Rain of Arrows (1-10), Shuriken Fan (1-11). Frost Nova up to 15% more at every gem level. Wheeling Axe up to 15% more at gem 9-20. Judgement up to 11% more at gem 4-9. Pyre Burst 39% more at gem 1-3. Reap deals twice as much (the developer's notes say at hero levels 1 to 6).

Six new notables, one per class: Butcher's Ledger (Slams), Honed Wound (Melee), Ripping Barbs (Bows), Kindled Heart (Spark skills), Searing Verdict (Projectiles), Hasty Rot (Duration skills). A critical strike's Bleeding, Ignite or Poison keeps 25 to 35% of the crit's extra damage (since Patch 90 it kept none). Each has a price: less crit multiplier, less crit chance, less damage or shorter ailments.

The Heart Waygate is back in the middle of the tree, one point from every class's Waygate. Deep Battery, Cairn Garrison and Bone Bastion each give +1 to maximum Ballistas and Totems. Edgecaster 50% increased Spell damage (was 40%). Comet Step's burst 300% (was 260%). Patient Edge costs 10% crit chance (was 15%). Hollow Covenant costs 5% maximum Fire and Lightning Resistance (was 8%). Grim Sweep gives 7% increased Melee Bleeding, Ignite and Poison damage (was 20% Melee Poison). Keystones that cost Life now cost the same share of Energy Shield.

Two Necromancer Oath seats are now Mastery of the Reaping. They keep the six Oaths of Mastery of the Legion and add four: Reaper's Tithe (with a two-handed weapon 10% increased Melee damage; minions 10% increased damage), Grave Harvest (15% increased Armour, 4% increased maximum Life), Rotting Edge (12% increased Poison and Bleeding damage with Melee) and Wide Arc (with a two-handed weapon 10% increased Melee area).

Skills need their own weapon type again: no melee skills on a bow or wand. The Orbit support no longer fits Melee skills, and Cast when Hit no longer fits auras. Minion death bursts grow with area of effect. Totems gain life with Rupture Level and aim at your target first.

Support Tempering at the Forge from Rupture Level 100: five small levels per support gem, each easing its less damage line (2% at level 5; a support with no such line gains 0.5% more damage instead) and lowering its mana cost multiplier by up to 6 points. Set the level per support in a skill's window, under Tempering. Idol Recast rerolls a magic or rare idol. Rivenstones drop from Rupture Level 120 (was 150) and twice as often from events, the Catacombs, the Core and Pinnacles. Ancestor Idol +1 lines drop from Rupture Level 100 (was 150). Potions drop less: in the game data magic and rare monsters drop them 30% less often and Guardians half the time (was 60%); the developer's notes add that plain monsters below Rupture Level 30 drop half as many.

Several Ward crowns give more (Oathstone Ward 20% of Armour against elemental hits, Sanctuary of Thought 25% of Mana as Energy Shield, and others). The Abomination adds 6% damage per fused minion (was 5%). Windburst deals 250% of the last Bow hit (was 200%).
The online realm was wiped on 27 November and the Bleeding Trial league started. Drop rates are back to the normal rates, no longer raised for testing.
15% more damage: Shuriken Fan, Ground Slam, Earthshatter and Storm Spark. Cyclone deals about 5% less at gem level 20 and above (in the game data its late damage figure went from 17.18 to 16.15).

Necromancer minions now come with their gem level and stay. In the developer's notes: Summon Skeletons gives 2 at gem level 1, a 3rd at 3 and a 4th at 7; Summon Skeletal Mage gives its 2nd at gem level 10 (was 13); Raise Zombie gives 1 with double damage and life at gem levels 1 and 2, and the 2nd at 3. While you have fewer minions early, each one hits harder and has more life. The planner follows this from the game's log: up to gem level 21 for Skeletons, 12 for the Skeletal Mage and 23 for Raise Zombie, each minion deals as much more as the minions still to come (for example 3 Skeletons at gem level 5 deal 4/3 each). From gem level 20 on, the counts are the same as before. After you enter a Rupture only your own Golems stand (two could stand at once before).

Eyrie Watch now works on Arrow Totems as well as Ballistas: they last 60% longer, and placing one at your maximum refreshes the rest. Taken nodes that need a fighting style you are not using, like Twin Fang Discipline with a two-handed weapon, show greyed out in the game.

Tomes can take the Intelligence craft at the Forge. Forge materials can be sold on the Market as bundles, and the Market's Browse tab is now called Buy. Gems on the Wagon cost 216 gold and supports 108 at every level.
Riven Lords are out of reach for less time: at most 3 untargetable phases of 9 seconds (was up to 6 of 13). Gate, Warden and Elder bosses are away for 8 seconds (was 11).

Trap Support changed how traps add up: every trap now hits for itself at 50% less damage, where before all your traps together dealt one trap's damage plus 5% per extra trap. With 3 traps out that is about 20% more, with a single trap less. Brutality gives 22% more physical damage (was 12%). Increased Area gives 65% increased area (was 50%). Entropy from the Chaos support now implodes for 10% more, and Entropic Focus gives 22% more (was 11%). Bloodlust gives 1% increased melee damage a stack (was 0.5%).

24 skills hit harder. Mage: Frost Nova +65%, Zap +61%, Living Orb +50%, Chain Lightning +37.5%, Ember Bolt and Glacial Shards +25%, Storm Whirl +20%. Ranger: Piercing Shot +95%, Ballista +45%, Split Shot +30%, Caustic Arrow +25%. Samurai: Blade Vortex +65%, Shuriken Fan +45%, Thousand Cuts +40%, Flurry +15%. Warrior: Earthshatter +45%, Leap Slam +15%; Earthshatter and Ground Slam can now be used with a Scythe. Paladin: Judgement +40%, Holy Slash +30%, Orbiting Hammers and Pyre of Faith +20%. Necromancer: Marrow Lance +20%.

The Grave Golem gets three times as much damage from its level and the Skeletal Mage 2.6 times as much, so both grow more as you level. Brass Sentinels and other familiars can no longer be killed by monsters.

27 small Area passives are doubled (for example 5% to 10%). Road of Bloodlust gives +20 maximum Bloodlust (was 10) and 10% increased melee damage; Endless War and Blood Remembers give +10 (was 5). Bone Armour also gives 50% increased Energy Shield. The Dragonling's Aftershock now works with Ancestral Warrior's totem slams (the planner already counted it).

Loot rolls for your own class and skills, a clear with a stronger host counts toward your own progress, and your sheet and DPS now include your party's Vows in range. The planner sims one hero and counts only your own Vows.
